runners.name: Valiancy
runners.spotlight: Signed off last term with a win at Haydock (1m6f, good) on the only time he's worn cheekpieces; overcame trouble at Hamilton (1m5f) on reappearance and although it was hard work when he plugged on from the rear to be sixth of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm; 9-4 favourite) it was his best performance on the figures and gave encouragement for 2m+; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Hard work at Royal Ascot (1m6f) in failed hat-trick bid, but it gave encouragement for 2m+

runners.name: Believitanducan
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 2024 on his only start on good to firm; won at up to almost 2m5f as hurdler; back to Flat with two wins on good ground (Ascot and Chester) and another on AW at Newcastle, last named the 20-runner Northumberland Vase in which he clearly held the upper hand through the final 2f; up another 5lb with a different trip, ground and track, but has to be shortlisted.
runners.comment: Up another 5lb and from 2m, with a different ground and track, but has to be shortlisted

runners.name: St Mawes
runners.spotlight: Not proven on firmer than good; two wins followed by two Goodwood places on his only four appearances over 2m for Emma Lavelle; first run for new connections was voided before the race warmed up; has a competitive mark and possibilities going beyond 2m, but this is also a better race.
runners.comment: Has a competitive mark and possibilities going beyond 2m, but this is also a better race

runners.name: Kentucky River
runners.spotlight: Latest Flat start was his first win, by 7l in a four-runner race at Pontefract (2m1f, good to firm) last August for Ollie Sangster; seven races over hurdles for new connections, winning two (2m5f/2m3f) of the last three; probably has a good mark, so needs a second look, but this is a step up in class.
runners.comment: 2m1f Flat win (four ran); seven hurdle races since, winning two (2m5f/2m3f) of last three
runners.owner: J R B Williams & Emdells Limited

runners.name: Berkshire Sundance
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces enlisted for last three starts, winning on first occasion and good sixth in the Chester Cup (2m2f, good); 16-1 for Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot (2m5f) six weeks ago but weakened right out of it in the last half-mile; that was his first race on firmer than good since start of career three years ago, so there's a big question mark about the ground.
runners.comment: Tailed off at Royal Ascot (2m5f) on first race on firmer than good since three years ago
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Duke Of Oxford
runners.spotlight: Eight AW wins, two last winter in 2m handicaps; however, he has tons to prove on turf record (0-6) and even best AW form does not look good enough.
runners.comment: Has tons to prove on turf record (0-6) and even best AW form does not look good enough
runners.owner: A Cope, B Roberts And J Biggane

runners.name: Charging Thunder
runners.spotlight: Below form on the Flat this year, for instance 11th to Believitanducan in the Northumberland Vase last month; not proven beyond 2m in this sphere but he switched back to hurdles for a 2m6f win at Stratford 12 days ago, which might give some renewed hope.
runners.comment: Below form on the Flat this year; back to hurdles for a 2m6f win at Stratford 12 days ago

runners.name: Gooloogong
runners.spotlight: 14th at 100-1 in this race in 2024; won at Kempton this year over hurdles and on AW Flat, and similar Flat form over that 2m on last two runs, but much better is needed from 5lb out of the handicap today; 7lb claimer is called up.
runners.comment: Consistent on Kempton AW this year but now 5lb out of the handicap; 7lb claimer enlisted

runners.name: Anniversary
runners.spotlight: Usually front-runner this year; not proven on ground firmer than good after two attempts, latest when well below form at Ascot three weeks ago; he's now been disappointing on three of his last four starts and he's not proved himself over 2m despite four stabs at it.
runners.comment: Disappointing on three of his last four starts and he's not proved himself over 2m

runners.name: Sea Of Kings
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden, with four seconds including at Doncaster (1m4f; odds-on) and Pontefract (2m1f; made most in first-time cheekpieces) on his two starts this season; reverts to just a tongue-tie and relatively unexposed as a stayer but others have to be more persuasive.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden, with four seconds including both starts (2m1f latest) this season

runners.name: Aggagio
runners.spotlight: All British Flat wins (five of them) have been at Goodwood but the last four were on soft ground, latest in June 2025; sixth in this race in 2023 and fifth last year, both on soft; last August saw his only run on good to firm in the last three years and he wasn't discredited, but he needs to step up on this year's efforts, particularly as he's 4lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Sixth in this in 2023 and fifth last year, both on soft which suits him; below form 2026

runners.name: Annabel's Ghost
runners.spotlight: 4-22 in France, including two 2m wins; changed hands and left Andre Fabre before having a crack at a Royal Ascot handicap (2m4f, good to firm) in which he came from well off the pace to be fifth of 20; that good effort (off 1lb lower than today) puts him in the picture.
runners.comment: Came from well off pace to be 5th of 20 at Royal Ascot (2m4f, good to firm) off 1lb lower

runners.name: Trojan Sun
runners.spotlight: Running away with a 2m2f race on heavy going under 7lb claimer at Nottingham last October was a clear career best at the time; virtually matched that form in three of his races in a mixed campaign this year and maybe an increased stamina test will help, but being 5lb out of the handicap won't.
runners.comment: Maybe an increased stamina test will help, but being 5lb out of the handicap won't

runners.name: Maxi King
runners.spotlight: Reliable 6yo who was a close second in the Chester Cup (2m2f, good; 3lb higher today) on reappearance under Toby Moore; not so good in the Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot (2m5f, good to firm) but he did stay on into a fairly remote fourth; strong each-way candidate.
runners.comment: Close 2nd in Chester Cup under Toby Moore; fourth in 2m5f Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Highwind
runners.spotlight: The lack of any win since a maiden hurdle in January 2024 (first run for Willie Mullins) is a concern but he's produced solid efforts on Flat over 2m2f, 1m6f and 2m on his last three starts and may well be an out-and-out stayer; no shock if he's on the premises.
runners.comment: On a losing run but last three Flat starts were solid; may well be an out-and-out stayer

runners.name: Alphonse Le Grande
runners.spotlight: Held up and stays 2m4f; a superb 2024 culminated in his Cesarewitch win at Newmarket off the same mark as today; 2025 campaign went from promising to frustrating (including with trouble in running) to disappointing; however, his fifth of 20 to Believitanducan in Northumberland Vase at Newcastle five weeks ago was a step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Fifth of 20 to Believitanducan in Northumberland Vase was step back in the right direction

runners.name: Defiantly
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo; proved that he does indeed possess serious stamina when upped from 1m6f to 2m4f at Royal Ascot (good to firm) last time, bang there almost throughout in first-time blinkers and beaten a head; back up 4lb but has a big shout.
runners.comment: Up to 2m4f at Royal Ascot and bang there almost throughout in blinkers, beaten a head

runners.name: Talk Of New York
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt whose record is 3-5; came off strong pace set by a stablemate and stormed clear to win the Heron Stakes at Sandown on penultimate start, then ran well in the St James's Palace Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) despite pulling hard in the early stages; the form pick and his chance will be cemented if settling better than last time.
runners.comment: Progressive; ran well in the St James's Palace Stakes despite pulling hard in early stages

runners.name: Saber Strike
runners.spotlight: Ran below expectations when a warm order for the Jersey at Royal Ascot (2-2 previously) but bounced back with a creditable effort against his elders in 7f Group 3 at York a week later, while leaving the impression he'll be suited by this step up to 1m combined with first-time headgear; remains of interest, with further progress still plausible.
runners.comment: Latest effort suggests he'll be suited by this new trip combined with first-time headgear

runners.name: Yazin
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery prior to reappearance win and now goes in first-time tongue-tie having dropped right away in the Heron Stakes; short of the standard set by Talk Of New York in this rematch but has the same strike-rate (3-5) as that rival and, with the Sandown run perhaps best excused, it's too soon to suggest he can't resume improvement.
runners.comment: Latest effort is perhaps best excused; too soon to suggest he can't resume improvement

runners.name: Catullus
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at 7f; had wind/gelding operations prior to easily justifying favouritism in Goodwood handicap; second best (behind Andab) in the near-side group in the Jersey Stakes since; the only course winner in this field and there are 1m/1m1f scorers on the dam's side of his pedigree.
runners.comment: The only course winner in the field and dam's side offers optimism as regards the new trip

runners.name: Andab
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2yo campaign with AW Listed win and has proved consistent this term, most recently best of the near-side runners in the Jersey at Royal Ascot; holds solid claims in another change of headgear, albeit is comfortably held by Talk Of New York on Heron Stakes running.
runners.comment: Consistent this term and has solid claims but is held by Talk Of New York on Heron form

runners.name: Five Ways
runners.spotlight: Useful colt whose 2yo form featured a success in AW Group 3 and fourth in the Middle Park, both over 6f; proved resurgent in 7f Listed contest at Chester most recently, making the frame; however, has something to find on ratings upped further in distance.
runners.comment: Proved resurgent last time but has something to find on ratings upped further in trip

runners.name: Shayem
runners.spotlight: Showed a strike-rate of 3-4 as a 2yo; has gradually found his form this season and recorded a clearcut success in Newmarket Listed event (1m, good to firm) most recently, hitting the line strongly and building on his second-place finish in the German 2,000 Guineas; back in the zone and may rate higher still; one of the main contenders.
runners.comment: Recorded a clearcut win in Newmarket Listed event last time and may rate higher still

runners.name: Indalo
runners.spotlight: Progressive; unlucky second in the 2025 Cambridgeshire and fared best of the far-side runners in this year's Royal Hunt Cup; justified favouritism in the Coral Challenge at Sandown (1m, good to firm) and is 2lb well in under a small penalty for that deserved change of luck; respected.
runners.comment: Progressive; 2lb well in under penalty for Sandown win that was a deserved change of luck

runners.name: Beagle Bay
runners.spotlight: Raced a tad awkwardly under pressure but prevailed in useful event at Sandown (1m, good) last time, taking record since handicapping to 2-2 and overall score to 3-5; subsequently withdrawn from the Coral Challenge because of good to firm going; improving 4yo who is a must for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Improving 4yo who is 2-2 since handicapping and 3-5 overall; has to enter calculations

runners.name: Bunyola Bay
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-4 features a clearcut win from the front in valuable prize at Gowran Park, showing marked improvement; returns to a more suitable trip/grade after trailing home last in the Irish Derby, and interestingly his yard landed this race with 3yos in 2013 and 2019; one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: Returns to a more suitable trip/grade; yard landed this race with 3yos in 2013 and 2019

runners.name: Tribal Chief
runners.spotlight: Comes with a degree of risk as he's often slowly away and needs the cards to drop right; however, form this term includes placed efforts in two major handicaps, while Goodwood record comprises a creditable sixth in this race 12 months ago and success next time; this may be the day to catch him, with renowned hold-up wizard Jamie Spencer up for first time.
runners.comment: Needs the cards to drop right but this may be the day to catch him, with Jamie Spencer up

runners.name: Scoville
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who looked a smart prospect early doors and whose disappointing runs are perhaps best forgiven in hindsight; had wind surgery prior to a resurgence, leading his group for a very long way, in the Royal Hunt Cup (handicap debut); interesting assuming he builds on that effort.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; had wind surgery prior to resurgence in the Royal Hunt Cup; interesting
runners.owner: Sir M Arbib,B Arbib,C Budgett & A Kheir

runners.name: Classic
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by a neck from Indalo at Newbury in May but has been unable to confirm the placings in the Royal Hunt Cup and Coral Challenge; current mark is stiffer than the one off which he finished sixth, amid traffic issues, in this race two years ago.
runners.comment: Prevailed from Indalo at Newbury in May; unable to confirm the placings twice since

runners.name: Walsingham
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 3-4 at Pontefract and 1-1 at Ascot; 0-16 elsewhere and his form since last success doesn't augur particularly well for this big assignment; failed to beat a rival when dropped back in grade latest start; first attempt at Goodwood.
runners.comment: 3-4 at Pontefract and 1-1 at Ascot; 0-16 elsewhere; first run at Goodwood

runners.name: Cerulean Bay
runners.spotlight: Blew his chance at the start in most recent handicap attempt but generally consistent otherwise in the last year and ties in with several of today's rivals on Royal Hunt Cup form; 2-2 at Goodwood and looks interesting back here despite remaining on a career-high mark.
runners.comment: 2-2 at Goodwood; interesting back here despite remaining on a career-high mark

runners.name: Blue Brother
runners.spotlight: Reached a useful standard in France; well supported for handicap attempts at Royal Ascot in 2025 (hindered by traffic issues) and 2026 (stable debut; creditable fourth over 7f) since racing in Britain; may well build on the reappearance effort and show progress; one to consider.
runners.comment: Ran creditably kept to Royal Ascot on stable/seasonal debut; may well build on that effort

runners.name: Darkness
runners.spotlight: Registered one of his 2025 wins at Goodwood, off current mark to boot; however, broadly out of sorts this term and needs to stage a revival; creditable fourth in this race in 2023 and 2024 but was in better form both times.
runners.comment: Creditable fourth in this race in 2023 and 2024; currently out of sorts

runners.name: Mister Winston
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-4 since being gelded features a success at Epsom on Oaks day when overcoming trouble; down the field in the Royal Hunt Cup 12 days later but perhaps the race came too soon; rested over six weeks since and may rebound.
runners.comment: Royal Hunt Cup possibly came too soon after Epsom win 12 days earlier; may rebound

runners.name: English Oak
runners.spotlight: Completed a Meydan double early this year; came up short in the Royal Ascot handicap he'd won in 2024 but ran respectably, behind an unbeaten rival, at Hamilton most recently; has to overcome the widest draw returned to a bigger stage.
runners.comment: Ran respectably last time; has to overcome the widest draw returned to a bigger stage

runners.name: Ebt's Guard
runners.spotlight: Currently in a consistent vein of form that ties him in with some of today's opponents; creditable third to Indalo at Sandown most recently; Goodwood record comprises a couple of second-place finishes at this meeting, including in this race last year; solid claims.
runners.comment: Currently in a consistent vein of form; runner-up in this race last year; solid claims

runners.name: Two Tempting
runners.spotlight: Very consistent on AW since last turf appearance; respectable seventh, despite enduring a nightmare passage, in this contest two years ago but is 5lb higher and lacks recent match practice in this compensation attempt; absent since March.
runners.comment: Respectable seventh in this contest two years ago; now 5lb higher and absent since march

runners.name: Archivist
runners.spotlight: Contrasting performances since fitted with hood, winning readily at Meydan but disappointing favourite in the Royal Hunt Cup returned to British soil; something to prove off an unchanged mark, which remains 10lb above the last one he raced off prior to UAE stint.
runners.comment: Won his final start during stint in Meydan; disappointing in the Royal Hunt Cup since

runners.name: Hawksbill
runners.spotlight: Ran encouragingly in a couple of races won by English Oak during his spell in Meydan and wasn't disgraced at Goodwood (7f) on Wednesday; however, still has a poor strike-rate as it's two years since his sole success; steps back up in trip/class.
runners.comment: Not disgraced here on Wednesday but still has a poor strike-rate; back up in trip/class

runners.name: Ozat
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo whose form figures of 0080 in Britain reflect that he's not a solid option; did well to finish eighth in the Royal Hunt Cup, having started slowly, but folded tamely in the Coral Challenge last time; best watched unless the market speaks positively.
runners.comment: Not particularly solid on British form; best watched unless the market speaks positively

runners.name: Ancient Rome
runners.spotlight: Landed the Chesterfield Cup at this meeting in 2023, initiating a notable double; however, has failed to score since and current mark reflects a broad decline in his form; drop to Class 3 had no effect last time and he looks a shadow of his former self.
runners.comment: Landed the 2023 Chesterfield Cup; current mark reflects a broad decline in his form

runners.name: Godwinson
runners.spotlight: Commenced last season with wins in the Lincoln and useful AW handicap; not in the same form since, latterly posting two duck eggs this term for new yard, latest in the Royal Hunt Cup when behind several of today's opponents; major revival is required.
runners.comment: Commenced last season with a notable double; not in the same form since

runners.name: Spicy Marg
runners.spotlight: C&D and Listed winner in last season's 2yo campaign, and she ran a mighty race when going close at 50-1 in the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot (6f, good) last month; failed to back that up in Group 3 at York three weeks ago but not ruled out in view of her peak performance.
runners.comment: Went close in Group 1 Commonwealth Cup; failed to back it up at York but not ruled out

runners.name: Jakajaro
runners.spotlight: 5yo front-runner who has been better than ever this year, comfortably winning a handicap at York (5f, good) in May and posting a fine fifth of 26 at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) last month; third in Group 2 Sapphire Stakes at the Curragh (5f, good to firm) recently and he could build on those last two efforts, which were on stiff tracks, now on a downhill course; respected.
runners.comment: 5yo front-runner who has been better than ever in 2026; today's track should be a good fit

runners.name: Asfoora
runners.spotlight: Three Group 1 wins, the latest last October, and second in this race in 2024 (seventh last year); step back in right direction when close seventh at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) but finished last at Sandown subsequently (slowly away) and it's been an underwhelming campaign; has to raise her game.
runners.comment: Three-time Group 1 winner but is having an underwhelming campaign; has to raise her game

runners.name: Time For Sandals
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) last June before fine third in this race under a penalty (good to soft); however, she's struggled to hit the same heights subsequently.
runners.comment: Group 1 win last June before fine third in this, but hasn't hit the same heights since
runners.owner: D Bevan And Mrs D Bevan

runners.name: Dickensian
runners.spotlight: Third in the Group 3 Molecomb over C&D (good) last July and reappeared with 3yo Listed win at York (5f, good) in May; not beaten far when seventh of 13 in Listed race at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago and still lightly raced, but he's down the pecking order on ratings in this line-up.
runners.comment: 3yo Listed winner in May but down the pecking order on ratings in this line-up
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Lamborghini Bf
runners.spotlight: Trained in Sweden, where he has posted comfortable wins in 6f Listed races on his last three starts; faces a higher calibre of opponent today and he was soundly beaten in a dirt Group 3 at Meydan in February, but he might not be a forlorn hope each-way in view of his more recent exploits.
runners.comment: Star performer in Sweden and he might not be a forlorn hope each-way

runners.name: Night Raider
runners.spotlight: Returned this year having been gelded and he's been an improved model, winning the Group 3 Palace House at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) and the Group 2 Temple Stakes at Haydock (5f, good to soft) before leading home those who raced in the centre group when tenth of 26 overall at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm); usually front-runs and this speedy track should suit him better than Ascot (ran well in this last year); strong claims despite 3lb penalty.
runners.comment: Returned this year having been gelded and he's been an improved model; strong claims

runners.name: Brussels
runners.spotlight: He's the sole Ballydoyle runner and was second in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf Sprint last October; however, unable to match that form this season and was behind Partisan Hero and Jakajaro at the Curragh last time.
runners.comment: Runner-up at the Breeders' Cup last October but unable to match that form this season

runners.name: Rumstar
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with good second to Night Raider in the Group 3 Palace House at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) and bounced back from below-par run at Royal Ascot to win at Sandown (5f, good) four weeks ago, taking that Group 3 for the second year in a row; has won here and is firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Group 3 winner at Sandown four weeks ago and he's firmly in calculations

runners.name: Argentine Tango
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Group 3 Molecomb (5f, good) over C&D 12 months ago and returned to form with Listed win at Ayr (5f, soft) last month; however, it's likely she'll come up short now back up in grade.
runners.comment: Listed winner at Ayr last month but likely to come up short now back up in grade

runners.name: Partisan Hero
runners.spotlight: 6yo who has been campaigned over further for the majority of his career but he's been a progressive sprinter this season, finishing third in a Group 3 at Sandown (5f, good) on July 4 then runner-up in Group 2 at the Curragh (5f, good to firm) last time; however, this tougher race demands more.
runners.comment: 6yo who has been a progressive sprinter in 2026 but this tougher race demands more

runners.name: American Affair
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 1 King Charles III Stakes at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) last June then missed the rest of the season; mixed form this year but he showed spark when second to Night Raider at Haydock in May and today's expected frenetic gallop will be right up his street; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Mixed form this year but the frenetic gallop will be right up his street; not ruled out

runners.name: Aspect Island
runners.spotlight: Third in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf Sprint last October and he's gone close in a couple of Listed races at York (5f, good to firm) this season, the latest three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained); however, his form has to go to a new level if he's to win this.
runners.comment: He's gone close in two Listed races at York this year but form has to go to a new level

runners.name: Azure Angel
runners.spotlight: Respectable effort in midfield in the Group 1 King Charles III Stakes at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) last month before 1l fifth of 13 in Listed race at York (5f, good to firm); however, a career best is needed today.
runners.comment: Arrives in good heart, close Listed fifth last time, but a career best is needed today

runners.name: Jm Jungle
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at this meeting in 2023 and he won this race last year (good to soft; seems versatile ground-wise); he hasn't been at the very top of his game this year but there have been encouraging signs on his last two starts and he could play a leading role back at Glorious Goodwood.
runners.comment: Has a good record at this meeting, winning this last year; could play a leading role
runners.owner: MPS Racing Ltd & The Ayrshire Tradesmen

races.race_name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises Bentinck Conditions Stakes

runners.name: Haatem
runners.spotlight: Below-par results this season but he may have needed his reappearance run here and got no run in the Wolferton at Royal Ascot (eased), having won that same Listed contest last year (good to firm); won the Group 2 Vintage Stakes here in his 2yo campaign in 2023; major player if at his best.
runners.comment: He's had excuses on his two starts this season and is a major player if he's at his best

runners.name: Crown Of Oaks
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on reappearance in Group 3 at the Curragh (1m2f, good) last month but may have needed that run and he was highly progressive in 1m2f/1m handicaps last season, a campaign that culminated with a win in the Balmoral at Ascot (good); retains potential and not ruled out.
runners.comment: Well beaten on sole run this season but highly progressive last term and not ruled out

runners.name: Galen
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner at the Curragh (1m2f, good) last April and went close under a penalty in the Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) in June; returned to form in that same Listed race last month, when fourth of 16 (good to firm; Dividend third), and he could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Returned to form with Listed fourth at Royal Ascot and he could have a part to play
runners.owner: Barry Taylor/T G Fitzgerald/Prof Paul H Redmond/Barry Fowler

runners.name: Ambiente Friendly
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Derby in 2024 but nothing like the same force now; after a stint over hurdles he was comfortably beaten in a handicap at Royal Ascot last month; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the Derby in 2024 but nothing like the same force now and hard to fancy

runners.name: Dividend
runners.spotlight: Won two handicaps in a row at Meydan (1m1f/9.5f, good) in February before Group 2 second there (1m1f, good); returned from break with good third in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); flopped at Sandown four weeks ago but very much of interest on his earlier form.
runners.comment: Flopped at Sandown four weeks ago but very much of interest on Listed third at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Boiling Point
runners.spotlight: Won the Cambridgeshire at Newmarket (1m1f, good to firm) last September and added a Listed win here (1m2f, good) in May, narrowly beating Naqeeb; this front-runner has remained in good form and can make a bold bid.
runners.comment: He's continued in good form since Listed win here in May; can make another bold bid
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Jonquil
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 2 Celebration Mile here (good to firm) last August and bagged Listed win at Ascot (1m, good to firm) in May; below par in Group 1 and Group 2 races on last two runs and entitled to respect back down in grade.
runners.comment: Won 1m Group 2 here last August; below par on last two runs but drops back in grade

runners.name: Diego Ventura
runners.spotlight: Listed winner at Longchamp (7f, good to soft) last May, then beaten on his next eight starts before winning five-runner handicap at Hamilton (8.3f, good) last month; today's task is tougher and he may be vulnerable.
runners.comment: Back to winning ways in five-runner handicap at Hamilton but today's task is tougher

runners.name: Dubai Champion
runners.spotlight: Ryan Moore won on his only previous ride for Ben Haslam, and this colt won comfortably at Hamilton last time (5f, good to soft); that wasn't a strong race with the runner-up now 0-6 and it's worth noting that he was taken out of a York engagement last month on account of good to firm ground (was due to step up to 6f); however, the Moore link heightens interest for sure.
runners.comment: Fast ground a grey area but impressed in his maiden and Ryan Moore is booked
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

runners.name: Innichen
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt who had a break of two months after winning his maiden (5f, good) and he beat a consistent rival with the pair clear in a 6f nursery at Nottingham (good to firm); an 8lb rise demands more in this deeper race and stall 1 might not be ideal.
runners.comment: An 8lb rise demands more in this deeper race and stall 1 might not be ideal

runners.name: Global Success
runners.spotlight: Improved for the cheekpieces at Newbury (6f, good to firm) when beating all bar a well-backed newcomer; whether that form is good enough to defy this mark is debatable but she lurks off a feather weight.
runners.comment: Improved for the cheekpieces at Newbury when beating all bar a well-backed newcomer

runners.name: May Bee In Profit
runners.spotlight: Promising efforts before getting off the mark on her fourth start in a novice at Carlisle (5f, good; proven at 6f) two months ago; nursery newcomer and encouraging that she's progressed her RPRs with each run.
runners.comment: Nursery newcomer and encouraging that she's progressed her RPRs with each run

runners.name: The Dancing Pirate
runners.spotlight: Home-bred colt from a fine sprinting family; a beaten favourite on debut at Newmarket's Guineas meeting; has got closer in his subsequent races, finishing right behind Clash Of Hearts at Beverley (5f, good to firm) and his Chester conqueror had the form that entitled him to favouritism (6f, good); the potential is there to raise his game on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Well bred and positives to take from all his runs; interesting newcomer to handicaps

runners.name: Super Tuscan
runners.spotlight: Gelded after second start; held up when far too good for his rivals in a Class 5 novice at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) but raced up with the pace when a fader on handicap debut at York; that was underwhelming but perhaps he'll seek more cover this time.
runners.comment: York last time was underwhelming but perhaps he'll seek more cover this time

runners.name: Jaijai
runners.spotlight: Confined to 5f since running over 6f on Ascot debut; won a small-field maiden here (good) but came up short in a three-runner nursery at Windsor (good to firm) despite having the run of things up front; he did rally late on, suggesting 6f could be more his trip, but his yard may have better chances.
runners.comment: A rallying second off this mark at Windsor (5f) but only three ran

runners.name: Paper View
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten since gelded, with 6f wins on good to firm at Nottingham (maiden) and Ripon four days ago (nursery); that recent win was never in much doubt having travelled strongly and, although penalised accordingly, the iron is hot; respected.
runners.comment: Penalised for recent Ripon win but that was never in much doubt; the iron is hot

runners.name: Arabica Queen
runners.spotlight: Dug deep to edge home in a Newbury novice (6f, good to firm) and probably performed at least as well when a close third on nursery debut at Windsor (11-2); she was given every chance that day and therefore looks vulnerable off an untouched mark.
runners.comment: Given every chance when third at Windsor and competes here off an untouched mark

runners.name: Moonlight Tango
runners.spotlight: All runs over 5f; she made all to win her maiden at Beverley on good to soft (beating May Bee In Profit) before trailing home last in the same track's Hilary Needler (good to firm); again showed plenty of early speed that day so questionable whether she wants this extra furlong.
runners.comment: Questionable whether she wants this extra furlong; probably not good enough anyway

runners.name: Persian Spring
runners.spotlight: Stayed on well to win in a good time at York's Dante meeting in May (6f, good) and plenty of scrimmaging meant he didn't get the chance to show what he could do when dropped back to 5f in the Group 2 Norfolk at Royal Ascot (good to firm); interesting that he was a late withdrawal from the Group 2 July Stakes and retains an entry at that level; returns to 6f for his first nursery and one to consider.
runners.comment: York winner who was badly hampered in the Norfolk; retains potential and Group 2-entered

runners.name: Clash Of Hearts
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; finished third of 15 (subsequently promoted to second) in a York novice (6f, good) won by Persian Spring (who now has to concede him 4lb) and has built on that, notably in winning by 5l at Pontefract (6f, good) 40 days ago (made all at odds-on); going the right way and one to be interested in.
runners.comment: 5l winner last time and also respected on his York effort behind Persian Spring

runners.name: Wild Terrain
runners.spotlight: All runs over 6f; hasn't kicked on from his winning debut (good) but those heavy defeats came in the Woodcote/Windsor Castle and he's been gelded since Royal Ascot where he wore blinkers (now removed); hard to totally discount for last year's winning yard in case he has turned over a new leaf.
runners.comment: Struggled since debut win, though was highly tried; has had a gelding operation

runners.name: Perigord Noir
runners.spotlight: Has performed to a similar level in his first three races, dropped back to 5f last time at Sandown (good); cheekpieces now go on but he makes his nursery debut in a deep race and has to improve.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces now go on but he makes his nursery debut in a deep race and has to improve

runners.name: Social Spirit
runners.spotlight: His most competitive run was on debut and he's been worryingly modest in his last two races, latterly bringing up the rear on nursery debut at York (6f, good to firm; 10-1); not easily warmed to on the back of that effort.
runners.comment: Most competitive run was on debut and he's been worryingly modest in his last two races

runners.name: Sovereign Glory
runners.spotlight: Third and first (5.7f/5f, firm) on his two visits to Bath before coming up well short when 100-1 for the Norfolk at Royal Ascot; goes this far for the first time but he doesn't look obviously well handicapped.
runners.comment: Goes this far for the first time but he doesn't look obviously well handicapped

runners.name: Sky Secret
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden on fast ground over 5f at Leicester; finished fifth of 24 runners in the Super Sprint but it wasn't the hottest renewal of that sales race and he had no excuses from a good position; off this mark others hold greater appeal.
runners.comment: Fifth of 24 in the Super Sprint but there were no excuses and this mark looks high

runners.name: Revels
runners.spotlight: 350,000gns yearling who was odds-on when a 3l winner on debut at Redcar (7f, good); failed to fire in the Chesham at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm) but didn't have the ideal track position and it wouldn't be reckless to put a line through that run; looks sharp enough for 6f, over which he holds an entry in the Group 2 Mill Reef.
runners.comment: Debut winner before his ninth in the Chesham; drops back to 6f and probably quick enough

races.race_name: World Pool Bet With The tote Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Into The Light
runners.spotlight: Found his stride a little too late when pipped on handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good) in April; the winner was Lost Boys who's won two major 1m2f handicaps since, latterly at Royal Ascot, but this one's appearance at that meeting (1m4f, good to firm; 4-1) was a backward step when he was slowly into stride and only briefly threatened to emerge from mid-division; now tries 1m3f in headgear first time and these are early days; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Disappointing when just 4-1 at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) but could bounce back

runners.name: Mythical Valentine
runners.spotlight: Won at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May in his fifth maiden race; last of three on handicap debut at Salisbury (1m4f, good to firm; Pearl River second) one month ago was probably better form but more is clearly needed from him; cheekpieces go on and latest start suggests 1m3f may suit him better.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces go on and latest start (1m4f) suggests that 1m3f may suit him better

runners.name: Devil's Peak
runners.spotlight: Carried his head high in blinkers for last two starts but he challenged to win on the nod in a five-runner handicap at Newbury (1m3f, good to firm) last time, getting off the mark at the ninth attempt; up 3lb and into a much more competitive race, he could still be thereabouts but others make more appeal for win purposes.
runners.comment: Finally broke his duck last time; could be thereabouts but others appeal more for the win

runners.name: Pierian
runners.spotlight: Knuckled down well to assert at Salisbury (1m2f, good) and had a simple task at Yarmouth (11.4f, good to firm) in another novice later in May; put firmly in her place in a 1m4f French Listed race six weeks ago, recording her best rating nevertheless; more is needed on this handicap debut but the best has probably not yet been seen of her.
runners.comment: Two novice wins; put firmly in her place in 1m4f French Listed race; best still to come
runners.owner: Lord N P V J Rothschild

runners.name: Astracornus
runners.spotlight: Much improved on his first go in handicap company when emphatically landing a five-runner event at Nottingham (1m2f) in June; beaten a nose in a steadily run race at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago and, off just 1lb higher, it's easy to think that this will suit him better.
runners.comment: Won handicap debut and pipped in steadily run race latest, both 1m2f; this can suit him

runners.name: Magnatura
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a win here (7f, good) and started this one with creditable fourth of ten at Newbury; however, he faded right out of it at Newmarket (1m) next time and ended up nearly 10l behind Devil's Peak at Newbury (1m3f, good to firm) on latest start, which make him hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Won here as 2yo; ran creditably on reappearance but last two starts make him hard to fancy

runners.name: Waterford Castle
runners.spotlight: 1m4f didn't help when creditable seventh at Royal Ascot; runner-up in all his other five races this season, which could be construed as hard luck but blinkers now replace the recent cheekpieces after his defeat in a Yarmouth maiden last time; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: All those seconds could be construed as hard luck but blinkers now replace cheekpieces

runners.name: Leonardo Blu
runners.spotlight: Nosed ahead in the final strides of a maiden at Nottingham (1m, good) in May on second start; not so good and still looked inexperienced in a novice at Windsor (1m, good to firm) 18 days ago; this is a tough race for handicap debut but he's a scopey sort who should resume progress at some point.
runners.comment: Tough race for handicap debut but a scopey sort who should resume progress at some point

runners.name: Pearl River
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to win at York (1m2f, good) in May and good second of three at Salisbury (1m4f, good to firm) in June; top 1m2f handicap at York three weeks ago proved much too tough and he needs to resume progress.
runners.comment: Two good runs before top 1m2f handicap at York three weeks ago proved much too tough

runners.name: Silver State
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; four wins over about 1m this year and twice runner-up (Epsom and Chester) in quick succession when stepped up to 1m2f in June; kept on well under usual rider Rose Dawes last time and this trip is unlikely to be an issue, but further improvement is needed for sure.
runners.comment: Twice runner-up (Epsom and Chester) in quick succession when stepped up to 1m2f in June

runners.name: Steel Raven
runners.spotlight: Upped to 1m2f when showing improved form to win a ten-runner maiden at Pontefract (good) last time, travelling best before galloping on well to get up by a neck; this hot race for handicap debut demands plenty more of him but he brings clear potential.
runners.comment: Upped to 1m2f for Pontefract maiden win; needs plenty more but brings clear potential

runners.name: Echo Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied first time and improved when comfortably off the mark in a novice at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) in May, leading over 2f out; handicap debut was a tough task at Royal Ascot (1m2f; 20-1) and he tailed off having led 7f; dropped 2lb and early days.
runners.comment: Handicap debut was tough at Royal Ascot (1m2f) and he tailed off having led 7f; down 2lb

runners.name: Parisian Scholar
runners.spotlight: Won five of 15 races, including this month at Thirsk and Newmarket (both 1m4f on good to firm); Wednesday's 1m4f handicap here was a much sterner test of his credentials and he came up well short at 28-1, so others are again preferred.
runners.comment: Two 1m4f wins this month but he came up well short at 28-1 here on Wednesday

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Silver Lake
runners.spotlight: Improved upon her first three runs (7f-8.6f) to win on handicap debut at Salisbury (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago when upped in trip in a first-time tongue-tie (retained); it was a small field but she came clear with an unexposed runner-up and she's just 2lb higher today; this 420,000gns yearling could have lots more to offer for her top yard.
runners.comment: Won on recent handicap debut at Salisbury and could have lots more to offer for top yard

runners.name: Room Fourteen
runners.spotlight: Progressive since moving into handicaps in this hood and she made it 3-4 in such races when winning comfortably at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; a 6lb rise may not stop her today.
runners.comment: Made it 3-4 in handicaps with comfortable win at Doncaster and a 6lb rise may not stop her

runners.name: Folk Pageant
runners.spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row in May/June at about 1m2f (good/soft) but she seems to have gone off the boil subsequently, finishing down the field in two handicaps and one Listed race; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Won three handicaps in a row in May/June but seems to have gone off the boil subsequently
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Zgharta
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who hasn't been at her best this season but took a step back in the right direction when fourth of eight at Chester (10.3f, good) three weeks ago; she's well treated on the form shown at this meeting 12 months ago and it will be no surprise if she's in the mix.
runners.comment: Well treated on form shown at this meeting last year; step back in right direction latest

runners.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners.spotlight: After being progressive in handicaps (including on fast ground) she went very close in a C&D Listed race (soft) last month; soundly beaten in Group 2 at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) last time, when the trip wasn't an issue, but this 3yo is not ruled out back into a handicap.
runners.comment: C&D Listed near-miss last month; well beaten in Group 2 since; not ruled out back in h'cap

runners.name: Wisper
runners.spotlight: 8yo who made it eight wins from 48 starts when scoring on reappearance at Windsor (11.4f, good) in May; only third of seven there since (11.4f, good to firm) and may be vulnerable to younger legs today, but she's run well in the last two editions of this race and could do so again.
runners.comment: 8yo who could be vulnerable to younger legs but has twice run well in this race previously

runners.name: Spinning Lizzie
runners.spotlight: Strong 2yo form here last summer and she reappeared with a conditions race win at Kempton (1m, AW) in March; she's had some tough assignments since but hasn't really kicked on and is not obviously well treated.
runners.comment: Strong 2yo form here last summer but hasn't kicked on this term following reappearance win

runners.name: Foxy Night
runners.spotlight: Yard enjoyed a good month and this filly about sets the standard, having come away with an interesting newcomer at Southwell last Thursday; nothing wrong with her previous Ffos Las third either and she's respected in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Yard enjoyed a good month; this filly about sets the standard in new headgear; respected

runners.name: Rajiba
runners.spotlight: Three solid efforts this summer, latterly when not quite seeing out 1m on her handicap/turf debut a fortnight ago; one to consider back on the AW and back down in trip.
runners.comment: Three solid efforts this summer; one to consider back on the AW and back down in trip

runners.name: Kernow Rose
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to five-time turf winner Sunny Corner, who improved once handicapping (as did her dam, also for Stuart Kittow); no surprise to see her follow suit.
runners.comment: Half-sister to five-time turf winner Sunny Corner, who improved once handicapping

runners.name: Pink Pyjamas
runners.spotlight: 22,000euros yearling who's a half-sister to four winners; the market will show what's expected on debut but it wouldn't surprise were she to need some time.
runners.comment: 22,000euros yearling who's a half-sister to four winners; market will show what's expected

runners.name: Gilding The Lily
runners.spotlight: 250,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to Listed winner Brunch (twice successful on Tapeta) and useful handicapper Golden Voice (1-1 on Tapeta); looks to have been found the ideal race on her belated debut.
runners.comment: 250,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to two useful winners; likely looking newcomer

runners.name: Navona Grey
runners.spotlight: Debut Chester fifth well advertised since; looked to find the drop to 5.7f against her (stamina on the dam's side) last time following an awkward start and she's one to bear in mind; maybe in handicaps after today, though.
runners.comment: Drop to 5.7f against her last time; one to bear in mind but maybe in handicaps after today

runners.name: Marianne Mozart
runners.spotlight: A year between her debut for Charlie Johnston and her comeback for this yard, and absent for seven months since; came in for good support at Southwell in January, though, when pulling too hard; worth a market check again.
runners.comment: Came in for good support at Southwell in January; worth a market check again

runners.name: Esplanade
runners.spotlight: Big price for her Windsor debut recently, when finishing last after fluffing the start; will need a big step forward.
runners.comment: Big price for her Windsor debut recently, when finishing last after fluffing the start

runners.name: Shatin Beauty
runners.spotlight: Trainer saddled four big-priced winners on the spin early in the week; this filly would be the biggest shock of all, having finished well held in two turf runs.
runners.comment: Finished well held in two turf runs and would be a shock winner

runners.name: Star Of Commala
runners.spotlight: Easy to back and finished well held on her 6f debut here last November; would want to see good support from the outside stall under 7lb claimer Molly Keegan-Price (0-7 to date) before including her in calculations.
runners.comment: Well held on her 6f debut here last November; would want to see good support

runners.name: Espanita
runners.spotlight: Won C&D maiden in March, her second start, but largely disappointing since; raced too freely when midfield in 8.6f handicap here this month; drops back to 7f with hood fitted today; needs to get career back on track.
runners.comment: Largely disappointing since C&D maiden win in March; back in trip with hood added

runners.name: Generous Rascal
runners.spotlight: Placed twice over 6f for new stable this spring (turf/Polytrack) and also has form over 7f; needs to bounce back from a poor turf run in first-time cheekpieces two weeks ago but has slipped to a tempting mark and will be dangerous if he responds well to first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Ran poorly last time but has slipped to a dangerous mark; new headgear tried

runners.name: Al Muqdad
runners.spotlight: Operating below last year's peak form but posted sound effort when third at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last week and remains on same mark as for emphatic C&D success in November; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Ran quite well on turf last week and was emphatic C&D winner off this mark in November

runners.name: Piazza
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; made quite promising seasonal debut when fifth of 12 at Kempton (7f) last month but her turf run two weeks ago was underwhelming; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: 0-6; ran quite well on last month's seasonal debut but safely held on turf since

runners.name: Quick Quasar
runners.spotlight: Dominated from the front at Kempton (7f; wore cheekpieces) in March, his second handicap, but dropped out disappointingly on both outings last month (8.6f/7.3f); has a point to prove in first-time blinkers, and his tendency to race too freely remains a worry.
runners.comment: Free-goer; made all at Kempton in March, his second handicap, but well held twice in June

runners.name: Kit Gabriel
runners.spotlight: Didn't see out 8.6f when sixth here this month but finished close up off today's mark on consecutive 7f Polytrack starts in the spring and has possibilities on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Not at best over 8.6f here this month but has claims if judged on spring 7f Polytrack form

runners.name: Merry
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who displayed clear promise in all three qualifying races, most recently when fifth of 12 in 1m Kempton maiden in April; drops back in trip for handicap debut; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Displayed clear promise in all three qualifying races; makes handicap debut after a break
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing And R Mitchell

runners.name: Ballybunion
runners.spotlight: Made low-key seasonal/handicap debut when 13th of 19 at Ascot (6f, good) in May but had wind surgery during subsequent 12-week break and is dropped in grade for this AW debut; moves up in trip; could still have significant potential.
runners.comment: Made low-key handicap debut in May but drops in grade here and remains unexposed
runners.owner: I Foster, D Fish, W Dale & S Dale

runners.name: Uniter
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; made a low-key stable debut in April (6f) and was pulled up (lame) on turf the following month; back up in trip here; not the most obvious answer.
runners.comment: Made low-ley stable debut in April and was pulled up (lame) last time; others much safer

runners.name: Angels' Share
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f Polytrack winner last summer; well below best this year but at least her recent fifth of eight at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) was a step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Well below best this year but at least her latest run was a step back in right direction

runners.name: Gunfighter
runners.spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow on first two stable starts but rewarded good market support when scoring by a neck at Southwell (7f) this month and remains well handicapped on older form; high on the list.
runners.comment: Came good for stable at third attempt, at Southwell this month; still on good mark

races.race_name: Call 01902 390016 To Name A Race Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Tarot
runners.spotlight: Drawn wide on her Chester comeback before over-racing back in the hood over a stiff 7f last time; stable been enjoying a purple patch of late and she's one to consider back on the AW.
runners.comment: Stable been enjoying a purple patch of late and she's one to consider back on the AW

runners.name: Inside Story
runners.spotlight: Having a first run on Tapeta since winning her maiden at Southwell last autumn; the impression remains that she's capable of better and it will be interesting to see how she goes in the market back from a short break.
runners.comment: Impression remains she's capable of better; interesting to see how she goes in the market

runners.name: Paris Babe
runners.spotlight: Dual winner in France (turf, Polytrack) who's struggled in three runs for this yard having been picked up for 32,000euros early in the year; this more realistic, dropping from Listed company, but would want to see some support before considering her.
runners.comment: Ex-French; this more realistic but would want to see some support before considering her

runners.name: Bella Bisbee
runners.spotlight: Likes it here; came back to form last Wednesday at Lingfield (turf) but has little room for manoeuvre off this mark, albeit she'll be 1lb higher from the weekend; vulnerable to improvers.
runners.comment: Little room for error off this mark (1lb higher from the weekend); vulnerable to improvers

runners.name: Callahan
runners.spotlight: Made all when winning her novice on Polytrack last autumn (race produced winners); well held in two runs at Meydan in the winter, latterly in Listed company, but still has some potential at this level for her much in-form yard.
runners.comment: Well held in two runs at Meydan in the winter; still has some potential at this level

runners.name: Lili Marleen
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner in France late last year, since when she's unseated at the start and not seen it out in one run over hurdles; another non-completion for her new yard a fortnight ago, when pulled up at Newmarket.
runners.comment: Another non-completion for her new yard a fortnight ago, when pulled up at Newmarket

runners.name: Ghisa
runners.spotlight: Dual Tapeta winner for Ollie Pears last autumn before a fruitless spell in Dubai for her current yard; much better at Southwell six weeks ago, back from a break, and today's extra furlong will help; goes on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Dual Tapeta winner for Ollie Pears last autumn before a fruitless spell in Dubai; player

runners.name: Carnival Of Light
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard all three starts, latest when running away with a C&D maiden a fortnight ago (well held in 1m races on turf previously); remains unexposed but she'll find this somewhat tougher now handicapping at a decent level.
runners.comment: Remains unexposed but she'll find this somewhat tougher now handicapping at a decent level

runners.name: Orchid
runners.spotlight: Couple of absences since winning a 6f handicap here last spring off a 2lb higher mark; the return to Tapeta is an obvious plus point but she's very hit and miss, and will need to improve somewhat on this season's two efforts after two months off.
runners.comment: Hit and miss; has to improve somewhat on this season's two efforts after two months off

races.race_name: Thank You, Jane Broad, For All Your Support Handicap

runners.name: Lightning Glory
runners.spotlight: Proven competitive since handicapping, backing up her Southwell second with a solid turf debut last time (rather drawn away from the action); she's been upped 3lb, though, so will need to find a bit more if she's to break her duck.
runners.comment: Competitive since handicapping; been upped 3lb, though, so will need to find a bit more
runners.owner: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi

runners.name: Suggy
runners.spotlight: Three AW efforts better than his five turf runs, latterly when comfortably beating a subsequent winner over C&D early in the month; a 6lb rise demands more but he may well be up to it.
runners.comment: Three AW efforts better than turf runs; 6lb rise demands more but he may well be up to it

runners.name: The Stone Power
runners.spotlight: Expensive to follow in maiden/novice company in the winter before gelded; didn't look to quite see out 9.5f here on his second run back a month ago and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Didn't look to quite see out 9.5f here on his second run back; one to consider

runners.name: Lillie Margot
runners.spotlight: Made all when winning an ordinary fillies' handicap on turf early last month; ran to a similar level off her revised mark last time, again from the front, when behind Lightning Glory at Southwell; no obvious reason she won't go well once more.
runners.comment: Front-runner; behind Lightning Glory latest; no obvious reason she won't go well once more

runners.name: Highland Shah
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard a couple of times, including in the hood, and will have to settle better now going beyond 7f for the first time; however, backed up his Musselburgh win off his revised mark last time, when awkwardly away, and has improvement left in him.
runners.comment: Has to settle better now going beyond 7f for the first time but improvement left in him

runners.name: Constant Star
runners.spotlight: Found an ordinary maiden (7.2f) when off the mark here in the spring and has been held in two handicaps since; struck into at Windsor, though, before slowly away and hitting traffic behind Lightning Glory and Little Margot last time; stable form a big plus.
runners.comment: Won her maiden here; excuses in a couple of handicaps since; stable form a big plus

runners.name: India Gold
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard on her comeback and bettered that when a clear second to an improver at Bath seven weeks ago; nudged up 2lb for that and this is stronger but she holds each-way claims.
runners.comment: Clear second to an improver at Bath latest; this is stronger but she holds each-way claims

runners.name: Golden Mabel
runners.spotlight: String of poor efforts at huge prices this season; expect more of the same.
runners.comment: String of poor efforts at huge prices this season; expect more of the same

runners.name: Yes Waliim
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to the yard's useful sprinter Star Of Mehmas and has only run in sprints to date, regressing since returning from wind surgery last winter; it all hinges on the new trip and first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Regressed since wind surgery; it all hinges on the new trip and first-time headgear

runners.name: Always Blue
runners.spotlight: Inclined to over-race in three runs, including two in the hood, and she'll have to settle better from a wide stall going back up in trip; has shown a fair level of ability in maiden/novice company but needs more on her AW debut.
runners.comment: Shown a fair level of ability in maiden/novice company but needs more on her AW debut

races.race_name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap

runners.name: Roc De Fer
runners.spotlight: Short-priced favourite for his two handicaps, coming up short on first occasion (after six months off) but no mistake in 14-runner race at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) four days ago; 6lb penalty now but he had something in the tank and is almost certainly well handicapped in this bid for a quick double.
runners.comment: 6lb penalty now but he had something in the tank at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) four days ago

runners.name: Jodhpur Blue
runners.spotlight: Sole win in AW maiden as 3yo, from 20 races; there's plenty of evidence that he can be on the premises, though, including his third here in January on a rare run at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Sole win in AW maiden as 3yo, from 20 races; can be on the premises, though

runners.name: Joseph
runners.spotlight: Both wins have came on AW over 1m2f at Lingfield this year, latest in April; inconsistent last four starts, respectable fourth here (9.4f) latest; second once in March over 1m3f and this is his first crack at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Both wins on AW over 1m2f at Lingfield this year, latest in April; first crack at 1m4f

runners.name: Louie's Folly

runners.spotlight: No real sign of winning potential, including a 7f classified last time when in cheekpieces; now in blinkers.
runners.comment: No real sign of winning potential, including a 7f classified last time when in cheekpieces

runners.name: Asadjumeirah
runners.spotlight: Three wins on AW last year but now on a losing run of 20; there have been some near misses during that sequence but not of late.
runners.comment: Three wins on AW last year but now on a losing run of 20; below par of late

races.race_name: James's Gate Irish EBF Median Auction Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Ischgl
runners.spotlight: Rated 80 after four outings; runner up twice, on debut at the Curragh (6f, soft) when 6l behind Great Barrier Reef and at Listowel (6.5f, good) in May when 3l behind The Scallionator; not disgraced when beaten 8l in the Windsor Castle on latest; should go well in first time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Runner up in two of four starts, not disgraced at Ascot, cheekpieces on, can go well

runners.name: Joga Bonito
runners.spotlight: In the mix in all three starts at 6f-7.5f; beaten 0.5l when third of 13 in a Down Royal maiden (7f, soft) on latest; gelded since and cheekpieces now go on; needs to find a bit more to get his head in front.
runners.comment: In the mix all three starts, beaten 0.5l in Down Royal maiden latest, gelded, cheekpieces

runners.name: Otherworldly
runners.spotlight: Excellent run on debut at the Curragh (6f, good) when 0.5l behind useful yardstick Immortal Guard; out of depth in 6f Group 3 back there on latest but could do better dropped in class and the step up to 7f could suit (full brother won over 1m).
runners.comment: Fine run on debut at the Curragh, out of depth in 6f Gr' 3 latest, 7f could suit

runners.name: Good Newbridge
runners.spotlight: Calyx filly; half-sister to Polish 7f 2yo/1m2f winner Fa Mulan; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 30), half-sister to winners Grande Marques (5f Listed), Bubbles On Ice (useful 1m/8.5f inc 2yo/US), Equity Swap (1m2f) and Optimism And Hope (1m Ire 2yo/US); yard won this with a 50-1 newcomer in 2024.
runners.comment: Calyx filly, half-sister to Polish winner, yard won this with 50-1 newcomer in 2024

runners.name: Heart Of You
runners.spotlight: Lucky Vega filly; dam runner-up 7f turf in Japan, half-sister to useful winners Memorial Day (1m-1m4f) and Mutafawwig (6f-1m), out of 1m2f Listed winning half-sister to French Derby winner Anabaa Blue; likely type on paper, well drawn and worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Lucky Vega filly, dam from family of French Derby winner Anaaba Blue, check market

runners.name: Mirren
runners.spotlight: Outran odds of 66-1 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good), keeping on nicely from the back for a 4l fifth of 12; was 3.5l behind the third Sea Of Rain, who bolted up in a Leopardstown maiden last week; this stiff uphill finish could suit; interesting.
runners.comment: Stayed on well from the back for fifth at Leopardstown, stiff finish here could suit

runners.name: Petrolio
runners.spotlight: Space Traveller colt; price rose from E5,000 to E30,000 as a yearling; half-brother to winners Ravenglass (7f-8.6f inc AW; RPR 78) and Grey Sparkle (6f/7f inc 2yo/AW/Germany; 63); dam unraced sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Delizia, out of half-sister to King's Stand winner Dominica; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Space Traveller colt, E30,000 yearling, half-brother to two winners, market best guide

runners.name: Jisir
runners.spotlight: Tasleet colt; 25,000gns 2yo; half-brother to three winners inc Bur Dubai (12.3f GB/12.4f Australia; RPR 100) and Emirates Empire (1m4f/1m6f AW; 93); dam 9.4f-1m2f winner (inc AW; 74), closely related to 7f 2yo Listed winner Be Ready; likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: 25,000gns Tasleet colt, dam 9.4f-1m2f winner, likely best watched on debut
runners.owner: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah

runners.name: High Morals
runners.spotlight: Disappointed when well backed ahead of debut at the Curragh (6f, good); more like it upped to 1m at Bellewstown on latest, beaten 5.5l into second; 7f could suit on the evidence of that run and has a nice draw here; place claims.
runners.comment: Improved second effort over 1m at Bellewstown, 7f could suit, nice draw, place shout

runners.name: Sovreigns Joy
runners.spotlight: Kameko gelding; 30,000gns foal; brother to Italian 5.5f winner Berkshire Kameo, half-brother to 6f winner Startled Lady (RPR 70); dam unraced sister to 1m/8.5f winner Sir Antonino, out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; respected source and worth a market check on debut.
runners.comment: 30,000gns Kameko gelding, brother to Italian winner, worth a market check on debut
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & C G Bryson & Kevin Osborne

runners.name: Imperial Duke
runners.spotlight: Equiano gelding; half-brother to winners Lady Bin (Italian 1m2f/11.5f), Spanish Colt (Spanish 1m/1m1f) and Invincible Fairy (Polish 1m); dam unraced half-sister to 7f-1m1f Group 3 winner Sandiva and Danish 1m1f Listed winner Wentworth; tough task from wide draw on debut.
runners.comment: Equiano gelding, half-brother to three winners, tough task from wide draw on debut

runners.name: Pennsylvania Ave
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 4-1 on debut at Bellewstown (1m, good) but could only manage a 6.25l fourth; will need to improve plenty on that to make his presence felt here.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten when 4-1 on debut at Bellewstown, improvement required here

runners.name: Supreme Act
runners.spotlight: No impression on debut at Down Royal when 28-1 (7f, soft); similar story upped to 1m at Bellewstown (good) on latest; handicaps beckon after this.
runners.comment: No impression in maidens at Down Royal and Bellewstown, handicaps beckon

runners.name: Cromane
runners.spotlight: Slowly away but showed a bit of ability when a 4.25l fifth of 9 on debut at Cork when sent off at 11-2; bred to appreciate this longer trip but will need to take a big step forward to win this.
runners.comment: Slowly away but showed ability on debut, step up to 7f could suit but more needed

runners.name: Romance
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 66-1 on debut at Roscommon (7.5f, good) but shaped with promise, staying on nicely in the closing stages for a 6l fifth behind subsequent Listed winner Dancing Destiny; should improve for that initial experience but drawn very wide here.
runners.comment: Promising start at Roscommon, should improve but drawn very wide here

runners.name: Closefield Beau
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; 40-1 and faded after racing prominently on debut at Down Royal (7f, soft); may need a bit more time.
runners.comment: 40-1 and faded after racing prominently on debut at Down Royal, needs more time; reserve

runners.name: September Duke
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; finished down the field on debut at Roscommon but run wasn't totally devoid of promise; massive improvement needed to be competitive here, however.
runners.comment: Debut run not totally devoid of promise but much more needed to feature here; reserve

runners.name: Amigos Legacy
runners.spotlight: First reserve; soundly beaten in maidens at Dundalk (5f) and on latest at Navan (6f, gd-yld) when 250-1; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in maidens at Navan and Dundalk, seems safe to rule out; reserve

runners.name: Ocastle Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins in France in his early days; unconvincing chase form since his return from a long absence; made mistakes and was pulled up at Punchestown in June; previously blundered badly two out at Cork.
runners.comment: Two hurdle wins in France, unconvincing chase form since his return from a long absence

runners.name: Vicar Street
runners.spotlight: Beaten at short odds on debut in a bumper at this venue two years ago; won over hurdles at Roscommon last summer after a break; runner-up in a Listed novice here later that month, beaten by the subsequent County Hurdle second Sticktotheplan; ran out of steam on his reappearance in a 3m1f chase at Punchestown last month; likely to be at peak form now.
runners.comment: Second in a novice hurdle here a year ago, may have needed the race at Punchestown in June
runners.owner: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Mickie Angel
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler over 2m4f on heavy; pick of six attempts chasing when worn down late in a 2m7f Limerick handicap last Christmas (soft-to-heavy) and when chasing home a useful sort in a Wexford beginners' event four weeks ago; trainer saddled a smart novice winner here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler, placed in three of his six starts over fences, needs to raise his game

runners.name: Talk In The Park
runners.spotlight: Plenty of chasing experience; has failed to build on a fine second behind Intense Approach in this race last year; best of his six subsequent starts when second in a handicap at last year's Listowel festival; pulled up at Roscommon last time, early mistake may have harmed his confidence; may bounce back to pose a threat now.
runners.comment: Plenty of chasing experience, has failed to build on a fine second in this race last year

runners.name: Wendrock
runners.spotlight: Useful juvenile hurdler the season before last; best run last term when fifth off 130 in a 2m4f handicap at Leopardstown; tailed off over 3m1f on chase debut; suffered the same fate over 2m at Wexford; not a betting proposition at the moment.
runners.comment: Former useful juvenile hurdler, dismal form in two chase starts over contrasting trips

runners.name: Ballystone
runners.spotlight: Won for the second time over hurdles when taking a 3m handicap at this meeting last year; pulled up in a Punchestown festival handicap on his only run since then; trainer won this with Intense Approach 12 months ago.
runners.comment: 125-rated hurdler, stayed well when winning at last year's festival, no chasing experience

runners.name: Themanintheanorak
runners.spotlight: No luck in handicap hurdles since a Fairyhouse win in February; big task on chasing debut.
runners.comment: No luck in handicap hurdles since a Fairyhouse win in February, big task on chasing debut

runners.name: Seventy Eight Team
runners.spotlight: Low-rated hurdler/chaser; pulled up in a handicap chase at Punchestown last time; out of her depth here.
runners.comment: Low-rated hurdler/chaser, pulled up in a handicap last time, out of her depth here

runners.name: Glens Sensation
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner in 2023; poor hurdles form; has struggled in two outings over fences.
runners.comment: Point-to-point winner in 2023, poor hurdles form, has struggled in two outings over fences

runners.name: Antrim Coast
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over fences but has run well at times, including when a 1.5l second in this race last season for Gavin Cromwell; 2lb lower now and blew away the cobwebs after a 279-day break with a respectable run at Wexford earlier this month; preferred by O'Keeffe and an interesting runner.
runners.comment: Second in this last year, 2lb lower now, sharper for latest run at Wexford, interesting

runners.name: Shanbally Kid
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in three of last four runs for Willie Mullins; modest start for this yard in the Midlands National, beaten 20l into sixth; this trip looks too sharp (sole chase win at 3m7f) and others have more convincing profiles.
runners.comment: Modest first run for this yard in Midlands National, this trip may be on sharp side

runners.name: Yoradreamer
runners.spotlight: Things haven't gone to plan since a wide margin beginners' chase win at Wexford (3m1f, soft) in March; unseated and pulled up in handicaps at Punchestown and Kilbeggan; also beaten in three runner novice chase at Punchestown (3m1f, gd-yld); a bit to prove for now.
runners.comment: Hasn't built on easy beginners' win, unseated and PU in last two h'caps, bit to prove

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won over fences since 2023 but comes into this in good form; beaten just a neck in a Kilbeggan handicap chase (20.5f, good) on latest; raised 1lb for that and this is tougher but has run well on both previous visits to this venue so not totally discounted.
runners.comment: In decent form, good second at Kilbeggan latest, this tougher but has run well here before

runners.name: Where's My Jet
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over hurdles but remains a maiden over fences after nine runs and yet to trouble the judge; well held behind a few of these rivals in the Connacht National last time and a 3lb drop is not enough to tempt; preferred by Townend.
runners.comment: 0-9 over fences and yet to trouble judge, well held in Connacht National on latest

runners.name: Donnie Devito
runners.spotlight: 2-7 over hurdles; 0-6 over fences but has run well in defeat, including when a close third behind Intense Approach in a C&D beginners' here last year; weighted to reverse that form and shaped promisingly in prep run after 218 days off at Wexford; could be on a nice mark for first handicap chase.
runners.comment: Fine run in beginners' over C&D last year, nice prep run latest, could be on nice mark

runners.name: Rising Dust
runners.spotlight: Gained third chase win at Thurles in January by 0.75l off 8lb lower; soundly beaten off revised mark twice since and while trip and ground are fine here, the first-time tongue tie needs to eke out more.
runners.comment: Beaten off revised mark twice since Thurles win, new tongue tie needs to eke out more

runners.name: Kings Hill
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over fences at Limerick in March (2m2f, heavy) off 10lb lower; has backed that up with solid runs at Fairyhouse (2m5f, yld-sft) and when 4.25l behind Hermino AA at Roscommon (3m1f, soft); 5lb better off with that rival and kept ticking over with a spin on the Flat 11 days ago but might prefer it softer; blinkers on.
runners.comment: Won off 10lb lower in March, solid runs the last twice, may need it softer; blinkers on

runners.name: Littlefoot
runners.spotlight: Won two of first three starts over fences, a beginners' at Downpatrick (19.5f, yld-sft) and a Kilbeggan handicap chase (20.5f, good) off 6lb lower; tame effort when pulled up over hurdles on latest and needs to rebound in first-time visor.
runners.comment: Won two of first three over fences, pulled up over hurdles latest, visor goes on now

runners.name: Baltic Bird
runners.spotlight: 1-7 over fences; best run since his beginners' chase win at Down Royal (19.5f, good) last year came when a 3.75l third at Wexford in May (2m, gd-yld); disappointed in Summer Plate at Market Rasen latest; runner up in the QR handicap on the Flat here in 2024 so not totally discounted in new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Good run at Wexford in May, below par in Summer Plate latest, has form here, not dismissed

runners.name: Warriors Wood
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over fences in emphatic fashion at Kilbeggan (20.5f, yielding) in May off 7lb lower; not beaten far in both starts since, including when just 2.75l behind the winner at Killarney latest (2m7f, good); yard had a winner here on Tuesday; should go well again.
runners.comment: Two solid efforts since Kilbeggan win in May, yard had winner here on Tuesday, go well

runners.name: Addragoole
runners.spotlight: Won twice over fences in 2025, most recently off 9lb lower at Leopardstown in December (2m1f, yielding); has come up short in three starts since, weakening on latest when upped to 2m5f in the Topham at Aintree; stamina a query upped further in trip.
runners.comment: 9lb above last win, weakened upped to 2m5f latest, stamina a query at this distance

runners.name: Ballybawn Belter
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run when winning a nice pot at Limerick in December (2m3f, sft-hvy) off 4lb lower; modest efforts in three starts since and probably hasn't much wriggle room off current mark but has gone well here before, will like the ground and preferred by Cobden.
runners.comment: Won nice pot off 4lb lower in Dec', modest three starts since, has gone well here before

runners.name: El Champo
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; front runner; made all in successive races at Tramore and Listowel last autumn; no joy since but has now slipped to last winning mark and his course form figures over hurdles read 114; could make a bold bid if gets a run.
runners.comment: Front runner, on last winning mark, 2-3 here over hurdles, could make bold bid; reserve

runners.name: Jalila Moriviere
runners.spotlight: 1-6 over fences, the win coming in a mares' chase at Sligo last October; good runs in defeat the last twice in handicaps at Punchestown, beaten just 1.25l there on latest (2m4f, gd-yld) off 4lb lower; should go well, but has to definitively prove she stays this far.
runners.comment: Solid runs at Punchestown the last twice, raised 4lb for latest second, stamina a query

runners.name: A Penny A Hundred
runners.spotlight: Sole success over fences a mares beginners' at Ballinrobe in September 2024; ran respectably in the Mayo National last year but out of sorts in the autumn and miles behind a couple of these rivals on return from a break at Roscommon on latest.
runners.comment: Decent run in Mayo National last year, poor since, well beaten on return from break latest

runners.name: Intense Approach
runners.spotlight: Prolific over hurdles (5-11) but is just 1-5 over fences; that win came over C&D (good) in a beginners' at this meeting last year (Donnie Devito third); lost way afterwards but given a break and should be sharper for a spin on the Flat at Bellewstown 29 days ago; not discounted in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: 5-11 over hurdles, won beginners' over C&D last year, sharper for spin on Flat, blinkered

runners.name: Moonovercloon
runners.spotlight: 0-10 in chases but in the first three on five occasions, including when beaten a nose in this in 2024 off 3lb higher; generally struggled last season and no signs of revival on debut for this yard over timber at Kilbeggan in June; could be sharper for that, however, and worth market check in new visor.
runners.comment: 0-10 in chases, beaten a nose in this in 2024 off 3lb higher, visor on, check market

runners.name: Charlie Luciano
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over fences in a Kilbeggan beginners' on latest (25.5f, good), pulling clear to score by 9l; raised 6lb for that effort but has placed off this sort of mark before and the drop back in trip shouldn't pose any problems; player.
runners.comment: Easy beginners' win latest, has placed form off this mark, trip and ground fine, player

runners.name: A Law Of Her Own
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Peter Fahey with an emphatic win over hurdles at Punchestown (16.5f, gd-yld) in October; bought for E25,000 in November and this course winner is worth a market check on debut for shrewd yard with a tongue tie and cheekpieces applied.
