runners.comment: Easy win over hurdles when last seen, new yard, course winner, check market, new headgear

runners.name: Hermino AA
runners.spotlight: Back from a long spell in the doldrums to land the Connacht National at Roscommon (3m1f, yld-sft) in first-time blinkers (retained); hit with an 8lb rise for that and this ground may be on the quick side for him.
runners.comment: Up 8lb for Connacht National win on latest, ground may be on the quick side here

runners.name: Lord Lariat
runners.spotlight: First reserve; the 2022 Irish Grand National winner hasn't won since and recent efforts have not suggested a return to the winner's enclosure is imminent; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: On losing run since 2022 Irish National win, hard to fancy on recent form; reserve

runners.name: Shaool
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m2f (gd-yld) Curragh premier handicap off 15lb lower last September and followed up in a Listed heat at Leopardstown (1m2f, heavy); no impact when slowly away in three runs in Listed and Group 2 company this season; may be on tough mark back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Slow starter yet to hit form this season in pattern company, may be on tough mark

runners.name: Mr Vettori
runners.spotlight: 3yo signed off last season with a Gowran maiden win (8.5f, heavy); narrowly denied by subsequent Queen's Vase winner Limestone on seasonal return in 3yo race at Cork (10.5f, gd-yld); not disgraced in Curragh Group 3 on latest (1m2f, good) and now makes handicap debut; could be on a nice mark based on his Cork form.
runners.comment: 3yo, handicap debutant, not disgraced in Group 3 latest, could be on a nice mark

runners.name: Kingstonian
runners.spotlight: Good first effort for this yard when narrowly denied in the Chester Plate (18.5f, good); led and weakened into ninth of 24 off this mark in a Curragh handicap on latest (1m6f, good); drops in trip now and cheekpieces go on; favourable draw.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied at Chester, weakened at 1m6f latest, drops in trip, nice draw; cheekpieces

runners.name: Fixation
runners.spotlight: AW winner got off the mark on turf at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm) on latest 34 days ago; rider was taking off 7lb that day so with a 9lb rise, he's effectively 16lb higher here; however, this longer trip could unlock further improvement so not written off.
runners.comment: Effectively 16lb higher than when winning at the Curragh latest, could improve for 1m4f

runners.name: Touch The Moon
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly over hurdles at Listowel in May but last two runs on the Flat have been decent; 4l second of 10 at Leopardstown in early May (1m4f, good); 4.75l fourth of 12 at the Curragh 34 days ago; place claims off 1lb lower but needs to find a bit more to win.
runners.comment: Solid efforts last two Flat runs, place chance but needs to find a bit more to win

runners.name: Satono Chevalier
runners.spotlight: In fine form on turf and on the AW in 2026; has won three of last five starts, most recently on penultimate start at Limerick (12.5f, soft) off 4lb lower; 2m1f may have stretched at Killarney latest and drops back in trip now; place shout.
runners.comment: Has won three of last five, 2m1f may have stretched latest, place shout back in trip

runners.name: The Real Screamer
runners.spotlight: 3-3 on the AW but effective on turf and won easily on return from a 107 day break at Leopardstown in May (1m4f, good) off 8lb lower; had excuse when third of 13 (1.75l behind This Songisforyou) off revised mark at the Curragh latest (fly leapt from stalls); well-drawn here and in the mix once he behaves himself at the start.
runners.comment: 3-3 on AW, easy win at Leopardstown on penultimate, valid excuse latest, player

runners.name: Thread Of Gold
runners.spotlight: 3yo has won two of his four starts; scored in a Curragh maiden on debut (7f, good); came from the back to score by 1.25l in a valuable Leopardstown handicap on latest (1m1f, good) and the runner up was a big eyecatcher at Goodwood on Tuesday; should stay 1m4f on breeding but 3yos haven't got a great record in this race and he's 9lb higher now.
runners.comment: Landed valuable Leopardstown h'cap latest, up 9lb, 3yos haven't got great record in this
runners.owner: Team Valor International LLC & Gary Barber

runners.name: Navy Waters
runners.spotlight: 2-12 on the Flat, both wins coming at Down Royal over 10.5f (good) and 1m5f (yielding) last season; not beaten far in the Cork Derby in May and traffic problems when a 9.5l fourth at the Curragh latest; others look better treated.
runners.comment: 2-12 on the Flat, both wins at Down Royal, traffic problems latest, others better treated

runners.name: Tribal Star
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner is 0-9 on turf; stayed on well for a 2.75l second over 2m1f at Killarney last time and closely matched with The Kingstonian on Chester form in May; may need more of a stamina test.
runners.comment: Turf maiden, solid run over 2m1f latest and at Chester in May (18.5f), this trip too sharp

runners.name: Night Moon
runners.spotlight: Gained second Flat win when bolting up over 1m6f at Fairyhouse last month on return from a 143-day break; hit hard for that with a 14lb rise, drops back in trip and this is a much deeper race; drawn wide but could be more to come.
runners.comment: Bolted up on return from break on latest, up 14lb, drawn wide but may be more to come

runners.name: Dawn Rising
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner ran a huge race in the Cesarewitch at Newmarket (2m2f, gd-fm) last October, beaten just 1.25l into second; just 1lb higher here but hasn't really fired in three runs this term and this trip looks on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Gr' 3 winner, second in 2m2f Cesarewitch last October, this trip looks too sharp

runners.name: Narlita
runners.spotlight: Loves it when the mud is flying, just as it was when she won off 9lb lower at Gowran in October (1m4f, heavy); has run respectably on all four starts on her favoured ground this term and has gone well here before but this ground will surely be too lively for her.
runners.comment: Effective on heavy ground, 9lb above last win, ground surely too lively here

runners.name: Chica Guerrera
runners.spotlight: Gained third career win on latest at Down Royal (10.5f, soft), bolting up by 6.5l; handicapper took a dim view, hiking her up 14lb; this longer trip is fine, as is quicker ground, but a big career best will be needed to follow up in this tougher race; drawn wide.
runners.comment: Hit with 14lb rise for Down Royal win on latest, big career best needed in deeper race

runners.name: Port Of Spain
runners.spotlight: 3yo won a 1m maiden (gd-yld) at Punchestown last September; fine run behind Derby winner Christmas Day in a Leopardstown Group 3 in October (1m1f, yielding); not disgraced in London Gold Cup on seasonal return but bombed out in Ascot Group 2 on latest; others preferred.
runners.comment: Maiden winner and Gr' 3 placed last year, bombed out in Ascot Gr'2 on latest
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Immutable
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on the Flat, including over C&D last October, but all four wins have come on soft and heavy ground; excellent second in the Cork Derby (1m4f, soft) when last seen in May; just 1lb higher here but needs rain.
runners.comment: C&D winner, all Flat victories on soft or heavy, fine run in Cork Derby latest, needs rain

runners.name: Mo Ghille Mar
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Wexford in May; below best in that sphere twice since and was well beaten in this race last year; 4lb lower now but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Poor twice over hurdles since Wexford win in May, well beaten in this last year

runners.name: This Songisforyou
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since landing premier handicap at the Curragh in October 2024 (1m2f, good); remains 6lb above that last success but shaped as though coming back to form at the Curragh on latest and ran well at this meeting in 2023 and 2024; could go well.
runners.comment: No win since Oct' 2024, shaped well at the Curragh latest, ran well here in 2023 and 2024

runners.name: Pleased
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging Limerick debut in April, third behind an odds-on stablemate; still looked a bit raw when second (again behind a shorter-priced stablemate) at the Curragh; not certain to uphold that form with Porters Corner and has a bit to find with Cosmetic on Fairyhouse running last time.
runners.comment: Has a bit to find with Cosmetic on Fairyhouse running, closely matched with Porters Corner

runners.name: Cosmetic
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly is closely related to Group 1 winners Hydrangea, The United States and Hermosa; limited sort but a a breakthrough win looks on the cards following Fairyhouse second; Pleased back in fourth then.
runners.comment: A breakthrough win looks on the cards following Fairyhouse second, Pleased back in fourth
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Stellar Moment
runners.spotlight: Improved from debut when a staying-on third over 1m2f at Leopardstown; saw out this trip well enough when second at Limerick; not much improvement needed to win a maiden.
runners.comment: Saw out this trip well enough at Limerick, not much improvement needed to win a maiden

runners.name: Pampar Lady
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles; creditable second on recent Flat debut at Ballinrobe, though beaten 8l in a race of lower standard than this; now has to take on younger rivals and will need to find plenty of improvement.
runners.comment: Three-time winner over hurdles, creditable second on Flat debut though beaten 8l

runners.name: Essential Comedy
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in her two outings; 5l to find with Pleased on Fairyhouse running; more likely a handicap prospect.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in her two outings, 5l to find with Pleased on Fairyhouse running

runners.name: Porters Corner
runners.spotlight: Signs of inexperience on debut at the Curragh; did well to finish third, only one length behind today's rival Pleased; cheekpieces may help, and it will be no surprise if she turns the tables on the runner-up.
runners.comment: Signs of inexperience on debut at the Curragh, only one length behind Pleased, can improve

runners.name: Thisistheway
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles; career highlight a win in Red Mills Auction Final at the 2025 Punchestown festival last year;  declared for Thursday's Galway Hurdle.
runners.comment: Useful 122-rated hurdler, declared for Thursday's Galway Hurdle

runners.name: Emily Estherfaye
runners.spotlight: Phoenix Of Spain filly out of an unraced mare; hooded and apprentice-ridden for debut.
runners.comment: Phoenix Of Spain filly out of an unraced mare; hooded and apprentice-ridden for debut

runners.name: Elusive In Mayo
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister by Elusive Pimpernel to three winners on the continent; dam unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo/1m4f winner; best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Elusive Pimpernel to three winners on the continent; best watched on debut

runners.name: Acanto
runners.spotlight: Fair debut over 7f, well beaten on second start; does not appeal against younger rivals.
runners.comment: Fair debut over 7f, well beaten on second start, does not appeal against younger rivals
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs Wendy O'Leary

runners.name: Ocean Fire
runners.spotlight: Finished with only one behind her in a Limerick race in which Stellar Moment was second.
runners.comment: Finished with only one behind her in a Limerick race in which Stellar Moment was second

runners.name: Capolinea
runners.spotlight: Last of five at Killarney on belated debut; can be left out of calculations.
runners.comment: Last of five at Killarney on belated debut, can be left out of calculations

runners.name: Possum
runners.spotlight: Ran green on debut at the Curragh; likely to need more experience; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, ran green on debut at the Curragh, likely to need more experience

runners.name: Study Of Motion
runners.spotlight: 55-rated filly. minor placed form on AW in Britain; no apparent chance in a maiden.
runners.comment: 55-rated filly, minor placed form on AW in Britain, no apparent chance in a maiden

runners.name: Mapa
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden; flashes of ability in handicaps at a modest level; no apparent chance in a maiden; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, 21-race maiden, flashes of ability in handicaps at a  modest level

runners.name: Galileo Springs
runners.spotlight: Placed in bumpers; 102-rated winning hurdler; remote sixth on Flat debut at Roscommon in May.
runners.comment: Placed in bumpers, winning hurdler, remote sixth on Flat debut at Roscommon in May

runners.name: Run For Mahler
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; recorded a second hurdles win when beating Paul Townend's Galway Hurdle mount Murcia at Killarney; beaten 21l in seventh in a C&D maiden for amateur riders here on Wednesday; may get closer this time.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, good winner over hurdles at Killarney, well held here on Wednesday

runners.name: Shemiyka
runners.spotlight: Ran twice for Dermot Weld late last season; should be more mature now but unlikely to be good enough on stable debut; visored.
runners.comment: Ran twice for Dermot Weld late last season, unlikely to be good enough on stable debut

runners.name: Trumph
runners.spotlight: Beaten 21l on debut over 7f at Leopardstown last October; huge improvement needed.
runners.comment: Remote eighth on debut over 7f at Leopardstown last October, huge improvement needed

runners.name: Snaafy
runners.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough win at Wolverhampton last December; subsequent placed form in small-field events; worth considering on the strength of a recent second at Pontefract.
runners.comment: AW winner at two, subsequent placed form in small-field events, worth considering

runners.name: Jp's Express
runners.spotlight: Showed much-improved form when 33-1 third at Fairyhouse early this month; the winner Kirkland Sioux backed that up with a Curragh win; cheekpieces on for the first time now.
runners.comment: Third at Fairyhouse last month, winner backed that up with a Curragh win, cheekpieces on

runners.name: Femme Beauty
runners.spotlight: Solid handicap form (including a 1m3f Killarney win) before landing a claimer at Ballinrobe in June; has gone well for an apprentice on several occasions, so could so the same for 10lb claimer Danny O'Leary.
runners.comment: Solid handicap form before winning a claimer at Ballinrobe, could go well for 10lb claimer

runners.name: Dont Get Me Wrong
runners.spotlight: AW claimer winner at 7f last November; major improvement needed from two turf runs this season; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, has won on AW, major improvement needed from two turf runs this season

runners.name: Cosmic Funk
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maidens before second on handicap debut at Leopardstown; found to be coughing post-race after a lesser run on next start; fifth in a claimer at Killarney last time, one length behind Love Orchid; his new trainer fits him with cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Fifth in a claimer on latest, needs to step up on previous handicap form, cheekpieces on

runners.name: Ella's Gold
runners.spotlight: Placed in all but one of her five handicap starts; capable of winning one with just a little improvement; addition of cheekpieces could perhaps make the difference; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, placed in all but one of her five handicap starts, capable of winning one

runners.name: In The Gloaming
runners.spotlight: Looked in need of further when running over 6f at Navan on handicap debut; open to improvement, and cheekpieces may help.
runners.comment: Looked in need of further when running over 6f on handicap debut, cheekpieces may help

runners.name: Aurora Mist
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a claimer at Killarney, with Love Orchid and Cosmic Funk among those in front of her; 5lb higher than for Gowran win in May; tongue-tie for the first time.
runners.comment: Down the field in a claimer on latest, 5lb higher than for Gowran win in May, tongue-tie

runners.name: Down The Glen
runners.spotlight: Highlight of juvenile form was a 7f course nursery win on heavy, achieved at the main expense of today's rival Aquilla Star; hard to be confident after a below-par Leopardstown run in June; would benefit from rain.
runners.comment: Highlight of juvenile form was a 7f course nursery win on heavy, would benefit from rain

runners.name: John La Bear
runners.spotlight: Progressed to win a Dundalk nursery last December; might just have needed the run when fading late at Fairyhouse early this month; has a bit to find with third-placed JP's Express.
runners.comment: Finished behind JP's Express at Fairyhouse last time, may have needed that after a break

runners.name: Only One Scobie
runners.spotlight: Profited from return to soft ground when making all over 1m at Leopardstown, winning cosily by 5l from Cosmic Funk; fair third behind the ultra-progressive Meriden at the same venue on next start; struggled on good ground at Fairyhouse; any further ease would help.
runners.comment: Fair chance on the form of Leopardstown win and third placing, best on soft ground

runners.name: Aquilla Star
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to Down The Glen in a heavy ground nursery over 7f here last October; failed to cut much ice on her seasonal debut at Down Royal last month; much better when losing out by only a neck at Ballinrobe 11 days ago; first-time cheekpieces; definite chance.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck at Ballinrobe last time, ran well over 7f at this venue last October

runners.name: Love Orchid
runners.spotlight: Some signs of ability in maidens at two; fourth in a claimer at Killarney on latest; needs to improve on this term's handicap form.
runners.comment: Fourth in a claimer at Killarney on latest, needs to improve on recent handicap form

runners.name: Hassaniya
runners.spotlight: Fair runs in maidens before stepping up in trip for handicap debut at Down Royal, beaten 8l in third over 1m2f; did not quite get home over 1m4f at Limerick; high draw could make things difficult.
runners.comment: Placed in two handicap starts over longer trips, high draw could make things difficult

runners.name: Belle Nuit
runners.spotlight: Best of three runs last season was at this venue; big price when down the field at Fairyhouse on her handicap/seasonal debut; major improvement needed.
runners.comment: Best of three runs last season was at this venue, down the field on her handicap debut

runners.name: Casamorati
runners.spotlight: Ordinary maiden form; 33-1 when last of eight over 1m at Killarney in his first handicap; huge task against that background.
runners.comment: Ordinary maiden form, 33-1 when last of eight over 1m at Killarney in his first handicap

runners.name: Mr Perth
runners.spotlight: Not an obvious contender on three runs in maidens between March and May; still early days, may improve.
runners.comment: Not an obvious contender on three runs in maidens, still early days, may improve

runners.name: Priorstown
runners.spotlight: The first of his three maiden wins was his best; hard to be confident; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, first of his three maiden runs was his best, hard to be confident

runners.name: Tharaka
runners.spotlight: Uneven form for Ken Condon at two; made the frame three times and showed enough to imply that she is a potentially interesting runner for a trainer who targets this meeting astutely.
runners.comment: Uneven form at two, potentially interesting recruit for a trainer who targets this meeting

runners.name: Sweet Baby Zou
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly at Fairyhouse in June; that outing may have come too soon after a Gowran win four days earlier in first-time cheekpieces (discarded now).
runners.comment: Ran poorly at Fairyhouse in June, that run may have come too soon after Gowran win

runners.name: Good Man Jack
runners.spotlight: Three maiden runs over varying trips; 1m effort at the Curragh was reasonably encouraging, so perhaps this will prove close to his optimum.
runners.comment: Three maiden runs over varying trips, 1m effort at the Curragh was reasonably encouraging

runners.name: Blackjack Hills
runners.spotlight: Good form last autumn; went close at Leopardstown recently, but that was over 1m2f; not sure to stay, finished in rear in a 1m5f contest.
runners.comment: Good form last October/November, went close at Leopardstown recently, not sure to stay

runners.name: Celtic Druid
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back Dundalk wins under this rider in the spring; a pleasing third behind a useful yardstick Darius Dark at the Curragh on his penultimate start; not far off his best when second at Dundalk last time.
runners.comment: Goes well for this rider, possibly best on AW but ran well at the Curragh last month

runners.name: Trubshaw
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year, including a defeat of Quiz Test at the Curragh; has failed to find his best form this season.
runners.comment: Beat Quiz Test at the Curragh last October, has failed to find his best form this season

runners.name: Nancee Spain
runners.spotlight: Took a big rise in the ratings for a 15l Roscommon win last season; unplaced in two early-season outings; blinkered  first time; still a bit high in handicap.
runners.comment: Took a big rise in the ratings for a 15l Roscommon win last season, still a bit high

runners.name: Covert Legend
runners.spotlight: Has done most of his racing on AW; good Curragh run on penultimate start; chance if forgiven a failure at Carlisle; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, has done most of his racing on AW, good Curragh run on penultimate start

runners.name: Steps In The Sand
runners.spotlight: Beat Coulstys Way in this race last year, completing a hat-trick of staying handicap wins in the process; placed over hurdles this month; may be peaking at the right time.
runners.comment: Placed over hurdles last time, won this event last year, may be peaking at the right time

runners.name: Espritroyale
runners.spotlight: Placed for the first time at Down Royal last month but soundly beaten, needs to find extra; trainer also runs Blissful Bonita.
runners.comment: Placed for the first time at Down Royal last month but soundly beaten, needs to find extra

runners.name: Coulstys Way
runners.spotlight: In good form last summer, winning at Roscommon (1m4f, good) and second behind Steps In The Sand in this event; pleasing effort when third at Killarney on her second start of the season; one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Pleasing effort when third at Killarney, second in this event last year, solid chance

runners.name: Blissful Bonita
runners.spotlight: Good effort in a 1m4f maiden at Limerick last time; previously fifth in a handicap at the same venue; may find some improvement over this trip
runners.comment: Good effort in a maiden at Limerick last time, may find some improvement over this trip

runners.name: Tatum
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Leopardstown track last year over 1m4f/1m5f; has confirmed a liking for that venue this season; third to today's rival Cooley's Mist in a 1m5f event the middle of the month, as a prelude to last week's winning effort over 1m7f; up 5lb, can remain competitive.
runners.comment: Gained a third Leopardstown win last week, previously third to Cooley's Mist at same venue

runners.name: Cooley's Mist
runners.spotlight: Winning favourite over 1m5f at Leopardstown recently after two third placings; improving type; cheekpieces added after a winning display.
runners.comment: Winning favourite over 1m5f at Leopardstown recently, improving type, cheekpieces added

runners.name: Quiz Test
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Cork in 2023; decent form last autumn, including a close third over 1m4f at this venue and second in a 19-runner contest at the Curragh; made the frame at Gowran and Limerick recently; no stamina concerns.
runners.comment: Only win was in 2023, often placed, showing fair form recently, no stamina concerns

runners.name: Goin'
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in Germany early in his career, and Listed-placed; can be rated a possible future handicap hurdle winner on recent form; potentially interesting back on the Flat now.
runners.comment: Two wins in Germany, no Irish success, fair recent hurdles form, potentially interesting

runners.name: Lady Plimsoll
runners.spotlight: Won Ballinrobe claimer last summer; finished the season with second over 2m at Dundalk; absent since an early-season Navan run, fair third in a 1m2f event on heavy; longer trip and better ground should help her cause.
runners.comment: Second over 2m at Dundalk last December, absent since an early-season Navan run
runners.owner: Athlumney Farms Ltd & Eoin Baxter & Mrs M D O'Callaghan

runners.name: Bell Ex Too
runners.spotlight: Has hinted at winning potential; hard to fancy after a disappointing handicap debut (last of six) at Limerick.
runners.comment: Has hinted at winning potential, hard to fancy after a disappointing handicap debut

runners.name: Baila Conmigo
runners.spotlight: Recorded his third AW win recently; placed only once from eight starts on turf; declared to run in the 5.40 on Thursday.
runners.comment: Recorded his third AW win recently, placed only once on turf, declared 5.40 Thursday

runners.name: Lauro's Legend
runners.spotlight: Placed over hurdles; ordinary form in maidens; opening mark looks demanding; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, placed over hurdles, ordinary form in maidens, opening mark looks demanding

runners.name: Vantage Code
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; little impact in his first two handicaps; took a step in the right direction when second to Nermal at Roscommon; staying on well when third here on Tuesday; longer trip and hood may help.
runners.comment: Was staying on at the finish when third here on Tuesday, longer trip and hood may help

runners.name: Out On Friday
runners.spotlight: Veteran won over 1m4f at Roscommon last year and was second at Fairyhouse in May; two Galway wins among his career tally of eight, so not a forlorn hope despite advancing years; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, two Galway wins among his career tally of eight, getting on in years now

runners.name: Mr Rango
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft or heavy, latest over two years ago; fair form this season and proved he can stay when second at 33-1 over 2m1f at Limerick last month; below that level at Tramore last time.
runners.comment: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft/heavy, latest over two years ago, fair form this term

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: Produced back-to-back solid runs at Ballinrobe and the Curragh earlier this season; failed to reach the same standard in his next four races; had plenty to spare when winning over an extended 1m1f at Gowran last Saturday; unknown quantity at this trip, good chance if he stays.
runners.comment: Had plenty to spare when winning at Gowran last Saturday, an unknown quantity at this trip

runners.name: Uxmal
runners.spotlight: Top rated here at 105 and this three-time winner ran a very respectable race in a Listed contest at Limerick (12.5f, soft) on return from break on latest; won over this trip at Killarney in 2024 and ground versatile (won Queen Alexandra at Ascot in 2024 on gd-fm); the one to beat if running to his rating.
runners.comment: Top rated, ground versatile, pleasing comeback latest, the one to beat on the figures

runners.name: Galileo Dame
runners.spotlight: Best on very testing ground and was well held in the QR handicap here on Monday when 8.5l behind Teed Up; big swing in the weights with that rival but would make more appeal if the ground was heavy; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Best on heavy ground, well held in QR race here on Monday, cheekpieces go on
runners.owner: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited

runners.name: Counting Coup
runners.spotlight: Took the scalp of Daddy Long Legs on Flat debut at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); may have used too much petrol to get to the front early when fading into fourth in a Listed heat at Roscommon on latest; not discounted with sights lowered.
runners.comment: Beat Daddy Long Legs on Flat debut, creditable Listed fourth latest, not discounted

runners.name: Taipan
runners.spotlight: 8yo has won this race for the past two years on soft and yielding ground; soundly beaten in both starts in handicaps this term, but connections have likely targeted this race and could make a bold bid.
runners.comment: 8yo has won the last two renewals, well beaten both starts this term, better expected now

runners.name: Way Down South
runners.spotlight: Modest jumper (rated 99) is 0-2 on the Flat and rates an unlikely winner based on her latest two runs in maidens at Tramore and Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: Modest jumper, modest efforts in Flat maidens last twice, hard to fancy here

runners.name: Teed Up
runners.spotlight: Six-time course winner bounced back to form with an excellent effort in the QR handicap here on Monday, beaten just 1.25l off 88; this trip possibly on the sharp side but loves it here and not discounted for place purposes.
runners.comment: Six-time course winner, excellent run in QR handicap here on Monday, place chance

races.race_name: Zyn In-The-Moment EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Louis The Fifth
runners.spotlight: 215,000euros breeze-up 2yo; only third of four on Carlisle debut (5f, good to firm) but he found lots of improvement when a clear second behind a smart rival who dominated at Ffos Las (6f, good) two weeks ago; sets a good standard on that form and this well-bred colt should have more to offer; key player.
runners.comment: Chased home a smart rival at Ffos Las and he sets a good standard on that form; key player

runners.name: Sexy Chick
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling; 7-2 outsider of three and came from last when runner-up over C&D (good to firm) last month, with all of them newcomers and there were just two necks between them; that was a promising start but she was beaten 9l over 7f here last time and has bit to prove after that.
runners.comment: Made a promising start over C&D last month but she was well held over 7f here last time

runners.name: National Honour
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt who cost 180,000euros as a yearling; second foal; dam French 1m2f-11.5f winner (including Listed; RPR 106), half-sister to 5f Group 2 winner Soffia, out of Listed-placed 6f 2yo winning half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Al Jazi; yard has won this in four of the last six years and he's an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 180,000euros yearling; yard has won this in four of last six years; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Hayate
runners.spotlight: 90,000gns yearling, 230,000gns breeze-up 2yo; first foal; dam unplaced 1m/9.4f (RPR 49), half-sister to winners Burnt Sugar (6f 2yo Group 3), Brown Sugar (5f/6f 2yo Group 3) and Vespasian (useful 5f-7f), out of useful 5f/6f winner; has plenty of speed in his pedigree and he needs a close look on debut.
runners.comment: 230,000gns breeze-up 2yo; has plenty of speed in pedigree and he needs a close look

runners.name: Happy Daisy
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns yearling; ninth foal; closely related to 5f/7f winner Chartwell House (including 2yo/Australia; RPR 96), half-sister to four winners including Star Anthem (Group-placed 5f 2yo; 99) and Stratton Street (5f 2yo; 92); dam 6f winner (102); plenty to like on paper but this looks a tough starting point.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on paper but this looks a tough starting point

runners.name: Blue Victory
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; closely related to three winners including Good Effort (prolific 5f-7f including Listed; RPR 114) and Crown Of Light (6f 2yo; 83), half-brother to two winners including Frostmagic (1m-1m4f; 82); dam unraced; yard has 35% record with 2yos this year and he needs watching in the market on debut.
runners.comment: Well-related colt and yard is 35% with 2yos this season; needs watching in market on debut

runners.name: Cloud Summit
runners.spotlight: Made a promising start when fourth at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) last month but he failed to build on that when a well-held sixth at Lingfield (7f, AW) three weeks ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Promising fourth on Newbury debut but he was beaten 7l at Lingfield (7f, AW) last time

races.race_name: Zyn Pacesetter Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Aleatrix
runners.spotlight: Study Of Man half-sister to four winners, notably Ebury (1m; RPR 100); dam 1m4f scorer (82), closely related to Derby runner-up Dragon Dancer; 100-30 on Salisbury debut (1m2f, good to firm) last month and she made virtually all before winning by 3l; that was a bright start and she sets a good standard under a penalty.
runners.comment: Made a bright start with her dominant display at Salisbury; respected under a penalty

runners.name: Without Prejudice
runners.spotlight: 125,000gns foal, 240,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to three winners including Emily Upjohn (9.4f-1m4f including Group 1 Coronation Cup; RPR 123) and Mushaireb (7f/1m including Australia; 91); dam 1m2f winner (97), sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Hazarista; interesting newcomer for the Gosdens and she needs a close look.
runners.comment: 240,000gns yearling; interesting newcomer for the Gosdens and she needs a close look

runners.name: Golden Island
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Island Bandit (7f/1m; RPR 88) and Brave Call (1m-1m4f including Australia; 86); dam placed 1m2f (78), half-sister to useful 1m winner Clemmie C; has good standard to aim at on debut and she could be one for later on.
runners.comment: Has good standard to aim at on debut and she could be one for later on

runners.name: La Mariposa
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise on her third start when runner-up here (1m, good to firm; 33-1) two weeks ago but she was beaten 4l and that form is modest; still early days but she has plenty to find with Aleatrix and needs another big step forward at this new trip.
runners.comment: Some promise over 1m here latest but she needs another big step forward at this new trip
runners.owner: L J Vaessen And Stephen Barber

runners.name: Spring Bloom
runners.spotlight: His last three wins have been over C&D and latest was in a Class 4 on good to firm 13 days ago; that was a narrow success but he finished well to beat the favourite and is only 2lb higher here; respected.
runners.comment: His last three wins have been over C&D and latest was 13 days ago; respected up 2lb

runners.name: Jimmy Knocker
runners.spotlight: Ended his abbreviated campaign last season with a win in this race; well held in his first three runs this term but he turned things around with a near-miss at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; nudged up 2lb but he remains feasibly treated and is respected back at this track.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and he got back on track with a near-miss at Newbury last time

runners.name: Currahee
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f winner last summer (good to firm/AW) but he's been well held in both runs this season including over C&D; now back on his last winning mark but he needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: On last winning mark but both wins have been at 7f and he needs to turn things around
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Robert Anstruther
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when justifying 13-8 favouritism with a comfortable win at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 7lb but that was a personal best last time and he's still unexposed at this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Off the mark with a comfortable win at Nottingham and he's a big player again up 7lb

runners.name: Good Earth
runners.spotlight: Recorded his 13th turf win when scoring in good style at Haydock (6f, good to firm) in April; struggled at York last time but that was a highly competitive Class 4 event and he was runner-up here (5f, good to firm) on his penultimate run; has claims if he can recapture that form and he's not ruled out on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: 13-time turf winner; struggled in Class 4 last time but has claims if he can bounce back

runners.name: Rebel Path
runners.spotlight: Won on the other course here (6f, good to firm) last May but he's been up and down since and has been out of sorts in his last two starts; now 8lb lower than for his last success but he needs a major revival with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but losing run is mounting up and he needs a major revival; headgear on

runners.name: Blue Samuna
runners.spotlight: Well held in five runs for Jane Chapple-Hyam including a handicap on the Rowley course here (1m, good) in May; changed hands for 6,000gns since; still early days but she needs improvement dropped to 6f on her stable debut; hood added.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly but she needs improvement dropped to 6f on stable debut; hood added

runners.name: Chiedozie
runners.spotlight: 26-race maiden who returned after a long absence in March and he's been tailed off in his last two runs; long way out of the weights here and he can only be watched; headgear removed.
runners.comment: 26-race maiden who has been tailed off in last two runs and is long way out of the weights

runners.name: Tanmawwy
runners.spotlight: His last win was almost two years ago but he's well treated on old form and showed signs of a revival with blinkers added when fourth at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last time; usually comes from off the pace and could be dangerous if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: Showed signs of a revival at Windsor and has possibilities if he can build on that

runners.name: Dancing Rinca
runners.spotlight: 7yo who often ran well in the US, albeit winning just once (6.5f, firm) back in 2023; sent off at 80-1 on British/stable debut over C&D last month and he faded into ninth of ten; wasn't beaten far on that reappearance run but others are preferred.
runners.comment: Ex-US performer; overall record of 1-27 and was in rear on recent stable debut over C&D

runners.name: Dion Baker
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has won five of his last seven starts but all of those were in Class 6 events and he was only third of six when well treated under a penalty at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last time; 6lb higher here and he has some work to do in this competitive race.
runners.comment: Has won five of his last seven but he was well held off 6lb lower last time; work to do

runners.name: Exposure
runners.spotlight: Ex-French gelding who has raced mainly at about 1m but he ran well to finish fourth in a C&D handicap (good to firm) three weeks ago; needs to build on that but he hasn't been with the Gosdens for long and this is a drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Hasn't been with the Gosdens for long and he ran well over C&D last time; possibilities

runners.name: Jumby
runners.spotlight: His last win was was in 2023 but that was a Group 3 event and he went close behind Where's Freddy over C&D (good to firm; 3-1 favourite) 13 days ago; on same mark here and he's a big player if he can repeat that form; visor added.
runners.comment: His last win was in 2023 but he went close behind Where's Freddy over C&D 13 days ago

runners.name: Where's Freddy
runners.spotlight: All four turf wins have been gained on this course (7f/1m); beaten around 9l in his first two runs this season but he returned to form when beating Jumby over C&D (good to firm) 13 days ago; only 2lb higher here and has leading claims if he can back that up.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner who beat Jumby over C&D 13 days ago; key player

runners.name: Renesmee
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort who was runner-up at Chester (12.3f, good) in May but she's not easy to predict and was tailed off in the Kensington Palace at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last time; back in calmer waters now but she looks weighted near best off this mark and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Six-time winner but she's not easy to predict and looks weighted near best off this mark

runners.name: Cherry Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Won on the other course here (7f, good) in May and he's finished runner-up over C&D and at Epsom (7f, good to firm) in last two starts; was beaten 3l last time but that was behind an improver and he's 1lb lower here; possibilities.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D and at Epsom in last two starts and he should go well again

runners.name: Miletus
runners.spotlight: Responded well to first-time cheekpieces when winning over C&D (good) last month but he was well held back here (fifth of seven) 13 days ago; finished behind some of today's rivals in that race and he needs to step up again after that.
runners.comment: Won in first-time cheekpieces over C&D last month but he was well held back here last time

runners.name: Physique
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who ended a long losing run with a dominant display over C&D (good) last month; struggled on his return visit three weeks ago but that was the Bunbury Cup and he remains well treated on his old form; respected on this big drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Out the back in Bunbury Cup but he won a Class 4 over C&D on penultimate run; dangerous

runners.name: Nikovo
runners.spotlight: In-form 7yo who has reached the frame in his last three runs including when third of 11 in a C&D handicap (good to firm) three weeks ago; finished ahead of Exposure in that race and he has each-way claims again.
runners.comment: In-form 7yo who was third over C&D three weeks ago; each-way claims again

runners.name: Sibling Rivelry
runners.spotlight: Improved her record 4-7 when coming from rear to score on her comeback at Windsor (11.5f, good to firm) in May; held in last three runs but she ran into two progressive 3yos in a Class 3 at Ascot last time; looks interesting on this big drop back in grade and she won in some tactical events last season.
runners.comment: Ran into some progressive 3yos at Ascot and this is a big drop back in grade; interesting

runners.name: Dance Time
runners.spotlight: All six wins have come on AW and latest was off 3lb lower at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last November; 0-12 on turf but she gave it a good shot under a prominent ride when third of 11 at Carlisle (1m6f, good) last month; now drops back in trip but she's a player if she can find a bit extra.
runners.comment: 0-12 on turf but she gave it a good shot when third at Carlisle (1m6f) latest; in the mix

runners.name: Society Girl
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden but she was beaten less than 2l when third of five in an Epsom handicap (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; was allowed to set a slow pace but she still has potential and could make a serious impact if she can build on that last run.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who wasn't beaten far in an Epsom handicap latest; possibilities

runners.name: Huggable
runners.spotlight: 20-1 winner off 4lb lower at Epsom (1m2f, good) last August in her second handicap; runner-up on next two starts but much less impact since and she's finished down the field in her four runs this season; overall record is now 1-12 and she has something to prove at this new trip.
runners.comment: Down the field in her four runs this season and has something to prove at this new trip

runners.name: Spinney
runners.spotlight: Her standout effort in maiden/novice events was a 4l fourth of seven at Bath (1m2f, good to firm) on her penultimate run; opening mark looks on the high side but it's still early days and she's a possible improver on this step up in trip (dam a Listed-placed 1m4f-12.5f winner).
runners.comment: Handicap newcomer and she's a possible improver on this step up to 1m4f

runners.name: Mertoun
runners.spotlight: Unexposed gelding who has form figures of 211 in handicaps and who has won by 5l at Windsor (1m, good to firm) and Carlisle (1m, good) in those last two runs; up another 11lb but he still looks feasibly on his latest form and is open to more progress; major player.
runners.comment: Big improver who has won by 5l in his last two runs; up another 11lb but he's a big player

runners.name: Drifts Away
runners.spotlight: His first five wins were on AW but he's won twice at Yarmouth this summer including an emphatic success over 1m (good to firm; cheekpieces added) last week; has a penalty but that was a personal best last time and he's strongly respected.
runners.comment: Hit personal best with his clearcut win at Yarmouth last week; respected under a penalty

runners.name: Born A Rebel
runners.spotlight: Can miss the break and has a patchy profile; bounced back with a close second over C&D (good to firm) last month but she hung left when fourth of six here (7f, good to firm) last time; hood is now added on this step back up in trip but she comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D last month but she was only fourth of six here last time; hood added

runners.name: King Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Has turned things around with cheekpieces added this summer, finishing runner-up at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) before scoring in similar conditions over C&D six weeks ago; this is tougher off 3lb higher but that was a brave win last time and he remains well treated on his old form; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Resurgent 5yo who scored over C&D last time and he's only 3lb higher here; shortlisted

runners.name: Rising Force
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally on turf with big-field amateur riders' win at Doncaster (good to soft) in March and he scored again at Thirsk (also 1m, good to firm) in May; was better than ever with those wins but he's not threatened in his last three starts and he's still 5lb higher than for his last success; others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Two turf wins in the spring but he's not threatened in last three starts; others preferred

runners.name: Crimson Rambler
runners.spotlight: Won two AW handicaps for George Scott in March; fair efforts in the last two of his three runs for current yard but his latest second was in a three-runner race at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm); this drop back in trip could suit but he needs to find more to make the breakthrough on turf.
runners.comment: Fair efforts in last two starts but he needs to find more to make the breakthrough on turf

runners.name: Currumbin
runners.spotlight: His two Flat wins have been over 1m6f and 2m on AW; won over hurdles at Worcester last summer but he's been generally disappointing since, including in two Flat runs (1m2f/11.4f) this season; has plenty to prove and his tactical speed will be tested back at this trip.
runners.comment: Well held in both runs this season and his Flat wins have been over 1m6f and 2m; opposable

runners.name: Jedhi Knight
runners.spotlight: Two encouraging Flat runs for new stable, latterly when second of 11 at Pontefract (1m4f, good) 24 days ago; 1lb higher today but still holds stronger claims than many.
runners.comment: Two encouraging Flat runs for new yard, second at Pontefract latest; in the mix again

runners.name: Falaise Blanc
runners.spotlight: Just one win (1m2f, AW) from his 24 starts but he arrives in good form, runner-up in three of his last four starts; should give his running once again.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but he's finished 2nd in three of his last four starts; in the mix again

runners.name: Gemini Man
runners.spotlight: Won minor events at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) and here (extended 1m4f, good) in June; reportedly bled from the nose in his hat-trick bid and then ran poorly at Newcastle last week; not easy to assess.
runners.comment: Two wins in June, including here, but two runs since leave him with a point to prove

runners.name: Sophiesticate
runners.spotlight: Three times a course winner for Jim Goldie, the latest (extended 1m4f) last August off a 9lb higher mark; solid efforts on her last three starts; big run expected.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner; knocking at the door of late; another big run expected

runners.name: Yakhabar
runners.spotlight: Easy win at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in March but not at that level in six runs since; minor money perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Easy AW win in March but not at that level in 6 runs since; more minor money his best hope

runners.name: Mr Withington
runners.spotlight: 0-10 and he was unable to reward market support on his stable debut at Ayr (1m2f, good) 26 days ago; new accessories given a spin this afternoon but he does have to prove his stamina.
runners.comment: Attracted support on stable debut but failed to improve; neew accessories; stamina query

runners.name: Liberty Looming
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in 18 starts under both codes; plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Unplaced in 18 starts under both codes; plenty to prove

runners.name: Star Of Markinch
runners.spotlight: 42-race maiden who can't be recommended with confidence.
runners.comment: 42-race maiden who can't be recommended with confidence

runners.name: Ivynator
runners.spotlight: Regressive 8yo who can't be recommended on this year's evidence.
runners.comment: Regressive 8yo who can't be recommended on this year's evidence

races.race_name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Gerry's Darling
runners.spotlight: Down the field on her first two starts but she took a good step forward when keeping on for second at Redcar (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago; finished in front of three of today's rivals on that occasion and she may do so again.
runners.comment: Improved when second at Redcar latest, finishing in front of three of today's rivals

runners.name: Hey Up Ronnie
runners.spotlight: Shaped well in a useful seller at York (6f, good) on debut; beaten favourite at Redcar (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago but still ran to a similar level; should go well again.
runners.comment: Promise in a useful seller on debut; similar form when third at Redcar latest;  big player

runners.name: Coul Blue
runners.spotlight: £16,000 yearling; second foal; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Magistery (RPR 67); dam 7f winner (including 2yo; 95), half-sister to winners Sergeant Wilko (useful 5f 2yo/6f), Stately Home (1m) and Mister Guerrieri (Italian 5f/5.5f); stable have a smart 2yo in their ranks; betting revealing.
runners.comment: £16,000 half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Magistery (RPR 67); starts out at realistic level
runners.owner: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd

runners.name: Nosey Book
runners.spotlight: Not far behind Gerry's Darling and Hey Up Ronnie at Redcar (7f, good to firm) on his debut 12 days ago; open to improvement but it is slightly disconcerting to see headgear reached for so quickly.
runners.comment: Promise on Redcar debut when not far behind two of these; cheekpieces now added

runners.name: Thai Paddy
runners.spotlight: Down the field in both starts, including behind three of today's rivals at Redcar 12 days ago; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Poor form in both starts, finishing behind three of these at Redcar latest

races.race_name: Bernard Hunter Mobile Cranes Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Liveadream
runners.spotlight: 2lb better off with Amantha for a short-head defeat over C&D last month; low-key nursery debut last week where she was reportedly unsuited by the fast ground; still early days.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Amantha on C&D run last month; blew out on nursery debut last week
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 13 & P J Makin

runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when landing a C&D seller last month; went down fighting in a Beverley nursery two weeks later and she should make another bold bid despite her 3lb rise.
runners.comment: C&D win last month and backed it up with a good nursery second latest; high on the list

runners.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners.spotlight: She has finished third in her two nursery runs this month, running creditably but failing to improve for the addition of cheekpieces at Leicester 17 days ago; needs more to take this.
runners.comment: Two solid runs since handicapping but she will need another personal best to take this

runners.name: Bluestone Lady
runners.spotlight: Ran well for second at Newcastle (7f, AW) last month but she finished out the back on her nursery debut at Leicester 17 days ago; risky.
runners.comment: Good AW run last month but ran poorly on her nursery debut 17 days ago

runners.name: Aurora Valkyrie
runners.spotlight: Big prices for her three starts but she has shown promise on the last two occasions, third of ten upped to 7f at Ayr this month; can continue to progress.
runners.comment: Promise in maiden/novice company on her last two starts; unexposed at 7f; can do better

runners.name: Bigalo
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to nurseries and/or 7f when a front-running second of four at Catterick last week; could do with settling better but he is 3lb ahead of the handicapper and needs taking seriously.
runners.comment: 3lb ahead of handicapper after last week's Catterick 2nd; unexposed at the trip; contender

runners.name: Boutblummintime
runners.spotlight: Gelded after his second start and duly showed improvement by finishing fourth of 11 in a novice at Ripon (6f, good); moves into nurseries with the potential for better; new trip; check betting.
runners.comment: Better run last time and he steps up in trip for his nursery debut; unexposed

runners.name: Curious Rover
runners.spotlight: Won the corresponding race 12 months ago off 6lb higher; back to winning ways when seeing off ten rivals at Ayr (5f, good to firm; made all) 18 days ago; this is a higher grade but the horse he beat last time ran well at Goodwood on Tuesday; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Made all at Ayr 18 days ago and the runner-up has gone close since; won this race in 2025
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Montezuma
runners.spotlight: Often promised better as a 3yo; ran well over C&D on his reappearance in April and confirmed that promise by seeing off 16 rivals here eight days later; his progress has stalled more recently but it wouldn't be a great surprise to see him return to form back at Musselburgh.
runners.comment: C&D record reads 2212; revival could be on the cards back at this venue
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Mighty Magnus
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the year when comfortably winning a C&D handicap last month; two good efforts have followed, running well in the circumstances when third at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; the stalls can be an issue but he should be bang there if breaking on terms.
runners.comment: C&D win last month has been followed by two solid efforts; big player if breaking on terms

runners.name: Francisco's Piece
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo; it has been a struggle more recently but he is dropping down the weights and appeals as the type to come good soon; that may coincide with him tackling slower ground though.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark; revival may coincide with tackling slower ground

runners.name: Jer Batt
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; it has been a while since his latest success but he has slipped down the weights and both this year's C&D runs (in deeper races) were encouraging; can go well fresh and a big run is on the cards.
runners.comment: C&D winner; two promising C&D runs in April; can go well fresh; big run on the cards

runners.name: Monhammer
runners.spotlight: This C&D brings out the best in him and he had a near miss here last month; neither Ayr run this month has been comparable but he should be in the shake up back here.
runners.comment: This C&D brings out the best in him; close 2nd here last month; should be in the shake up

runners.name: Braes Of Doune
runners.spotlight: Not fired in two runs back from a 399-day absence; has won at this track and he is on a handy mark so not impossible he'll bounce back, for all the trip is on the sharp side.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but yet to shine this year after an absence; trip sharp enough too

runners.name: Sanditon
runners.spotlight: Two 7f AW wins this year; had few chances on turf but he has run well at Catterick in the past, including last month; still looked in top form when meeting trouble in running at Wolverhampton last time; contender.
runners.comment: Two 7f AW wins this year; unlucky in running last time; should make a bold bid

runners.name: Wait For It
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden but she has run with credit in two 6f handicaps this summer, finishing second of seven at Catterick last week; returning to 7f will be in her favour and she is high on the list.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden but running well over 6f this summer; good chance back up in trip

runners.name: Misemerald
runners.spotlight: Over three years since her last win but she has run with credit on her last three starts; others still preferred for win purposes.
runners.comment: Over three years since her last win; running okay but others appeal more for the win

runners.name: King Sharja
runners.spotlight: His three turf wins have come around the right-hand turn at Beverley; twice a runner-up in May but his form has dipped twice since; has the ability to feature at this level.
runners.comment: Capable at this level; needs to bounce back to his May levels but it is possible

runners.name: April Diamond
runners.spotlight: Kept on for second at Carlisle (6f, good) on her handicap debut last month; ran poorly at Ayr three weeks later; now steps up in trip with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Ran well on handicap debut but poorly 25 days ago; steps up in trip with a point to prove

runners.name: Gallus Norman
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps this year, making all for wins over C&D and at Ayr (1m7f, soft); there could well be more in the tank and he's a strong contender despite his latest 4lb rise.
runners.comment: Improving stayer; 4lb rise for latest Ayr win may not prevent him following up

runners.name: Cascade Hall
runners.spotlight: Two wins this summer, including C&D, and he wasn't beaten far at Ayr (1m5f, good to firm) 18 days ago; stable may have stronger claims with Gallus Norman.
runners.comment: Two wins this year, including C&D; stable may have stronger claims with Gallus Norman

runners.name: Inappropriate
runners.spotlight: Two solid efforts for new stable, latterly beaten a short head into second at Ayr (1m5f, good to firm) 18 days ago; twice a winner over hurdles but this will be the first time he has tackled 2m on the Flat.
runners.comment: Near miss over 1m5f 18 days ago; good chance if stamina lasts

runners.name: Arrange
runners.spotlight: On a losing run and her latest Catterick second came in a four-runner race; she will need more to come out on top this time.
runners.comment: Latest second came in just a four-runner race; losing run set to continue
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Simple Star
runners.spotlight: Three course wins over shorter but does stay this trip; mixed bag so far this year and he needs a recent stable switch (same owner) to spark something extra.
runners.comment: Three course wins over shorter; not at best this year and has changed yard since latest

runners.name: Teofimo
runners.spotlight: Modest hurdle form for this yard, albeit he was returning from 343 days off when third at Hexham last month; had fair Flat form in Ireland in his youth but does come with risk attached.
runners.comment: Modest hurdle form for new yard; current Flat mark likely tough enough

runners.name: Golden Havana
runners.spotlight: Running well since the visor went on in May and he has finished runner-up on his last three starts, the latest on Tuesday; should be in the thick of it again.
runners.comment: Running well since a visor went on; went close at Beverley on Tuesday; big player

runners.name: Peregrine Falcon
runners.spotlight: Thoroughly exposed maiden but she wasn't beaten far at Lingfield (5f, AW) when last seen eight weeks ago; has her first turf run in Britain; others look stronger for win purposes.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; can run well off this mark but others look stronger for the win

runners.name: Thornaby Pearl
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; the winner of two of his last four starts, latterly a 5f handicap at Hamilton (good) three weeks ago; that form has already received several boosts and a 2lb rise looks lenient; today's sharper test not sure to suit so well but he remains of interest.
runners.comment: In good form and latest Hamilton win is working out well; 2lb higher mark manageable

runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a C&D handicap last month; in and out since but she wasn't beaten far at Ayr on Monday and this mark is unlikely to prove beyond her; one to consider.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; in and out since but she's capable at this level

runners.name: Thunderstorm Katie
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last season; she had been running well in defeat prior to a lesser effort behind Thornaby Pearl three weeks ago; not discounted.
runners.comment: C&D winner; good run of form ground to a halt last time; capable of bouncing back

runners.name: South Parade
runners.spotlight: Should be making a big impact off her lowly mark but her 2026 campaign has been underwhelming thus far; has won over C&D and dropping into a Class 6 will help; still not entirely convincing.
runners.comment: Struggling for form this year and this C&D winner looks vulnerable despite drop to Class 6
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

races.race_name: Big Stage Hire Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Back in prime form at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last week, coming from off the pace for a clearcut success; raced only twice on turf (placed once) and untested on ground other than good but is 1lb ahead of the handicapper under her 5lb penalty and could still have untapped potential over this trip.
runners.comment: 1lb well in under penalty for recent 1m4f AW win; switch to fast turf not sure to suit

runners.name: Bumaan
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who came second in both handicaps, at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm); tries a new trip here and probably still has more to offer.
runners.comment: Second in first two handicaps (1m4f/1m2f); probably still has more to offer; new trip

runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Seven wins at up to 1m4f; yet fully to convince stamina-wise over this far and not very reliable nowadays but gave pretty good account when third in refitted cheekpieces here (11.6f, firm) 16 days ago.
runners.comment: Yet fully to convince stamina-wise over this far but was placed here (11.6f) recently

runners.name: Fabled Spirit
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in three 1m2f novice/maiden races in May/June and not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces may prompt improvement; market helpful.
runners.comment: Well down the field in 1m2f novice/maiden races; may improve in handicaps; headgear on

races.race_name: Trusted Betting Site Reviews gambling.com British EBF Restricted Novice (Bands B-D) (Qual) (GBB)

runners.name: Tricky Jenny
runners.spotlight: Raced too freely and disappointing on last month's AW debut (6f) but lost out only by a nose to Sheer Beauty when back on turf here (5f, firm) 16 days ago and is 7lb better off with her this time; obvious claims.
runners.comment: Very close second to Sheer Beauty here (5f) this month and 7lb better off with her today

runners.name: Sheer Beauty
runners.spotlight: Bullt upon encouraging debut when leading close home to pip Tricky Jenny here (5f, firm) this month; didn't get a clear run that day and has scope for further progress over this longer trip; respected under penalty.
runners.comment: Led close home to pip Tricky Jenny over 5f here this month; can progress again

runners.name: Havana Gift
runners.spotlight: Close second in Musselburgh seller (5f, good) last month and made the frame in both subsequent nurseries, albeit it's tricky to gauge what she achieved when second of three behind a 1-4 favourite last time; goes beyond a bare 5f for first time here; ought to be very competitive on these terms.
runners.comment: Fair form when making the frame in two nurseries; can be very competitive on these terms

runners.name: Texas Crown
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut in June (6f) but belied 150-1 odds when very close second over C&D (firm) at start of this month and has a big role to play if in similar form again.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut but belied 150-1 odds when very close second over C&D this month

runners.name: Thai Boxer
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam prolific 1m-1m2f winner (RPR 74), half-sister to a French 6.7f 2yo winner; rare 2yo runner for the stable.
runners.comment: Second foal from a prolific 1m-1m2f winner; rare 2yo runner for the stable

runners.name: Crimson Blaze
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when fifth of eight on debut at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in April but both subsequent runs (5f/6f) were disappointing; needs last month's wind op to have made a difference.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on debut but both runs since were disappointing; had wind op last month

runners.name: Zonneveld
runners.spotlight: Never dangerous when eighth of ten on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) a week ago; remains best watched.
runners.comment: Never dangerous on debut at Chepstow last week; remains best watched
runners.owner: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner

races.race_name: Bath Rum And Reggae Race Night 15th August Classified Stakes (Bath Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner who was beaten only by two necks when third in Class 5 Chepstow handicap (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; also suited by this C&D and commands respect on first dip into this basement grade.
runners.comment: Dips in grade after recent close third in Class 5 handicap; good chance
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner

runners.name: Rogue Rebellion
runners.spotlight: Gained his only win on Polytrack (5f) but was placed in this grade at Leicester (6f, good to firm) this month and has now made the frame on his last three turf starts (one was over C&D); must be considered.
runners.comment: Placed in this grade at Leicester (6f) this month and must be considered here

runners.name: Jackie Brown
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who went close in this grade at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, on her third start for Adrian Wintle, and ought to be better suited by this longer trip; likely contender.
runners.comment: Went close over 5f in this grade a fortnight ago and today's longer trip may suit better

runners.name: Spirited Dancer
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over C&D (good) and at Brighton (7f, good to firm) in refitted cheekpieces last month and has obvious claims if judged on those efforts but didn't fire on her latest outing and her overall profile is regressive; others preferred.
runners.comment: Second twice (once over C&D) in this grade last month but didn't fire last time

runners.name: Rinky Tinky Tinky
runners.spotlight: Made quite encouraging seasonal debut in C&D handicap (good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) in May but has not built on that on either start since, and was behind Jackie Brown when fifth in this grade at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Ran quite well over C&D on seasonal debut in May but is yet to build on that performance

runners.name: Sisters In The Sky
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his nine wins here, two on firm ground over this trip; kept on for second (no match for winner) off his basement handicap mark over C&D (firm) at start of this month and has each-way claims again.
runners.comment: Kept on for second off his basement mark over C&D at start of this month; each-way claims

runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: Has poor 1-52 strike-rate, the win gained on Polytrack (5f) in 2023; recent efforts have been underwhelming and he makes very limited appeal.
runners.comment: Recent efforts have been underwhelming and he makes very limited appeal.

runners.name: I Was Thinking
runners.spotlight: Placed for first time in seven-race career when coming from off the pace for third in similar C&D race to this last month (good ground); that was his turf debut and he could plausibly still have a bigger run in him if today's faster ground suits.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D in similar race to this on turf debut in June; shortlisted

runners.name: Symbol Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Third in similar C&D race to this (good; first run since rejoining this stable) in June and also ran well when third in recent 5f handicap here (firm) but is not one to rely upon heavily and sometimes races too freely.
runners.comment: Third twice here (5.7f/5f) in recent weeks but not one to rely upon heavily

races.race_name: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Honky Tonk Girl
runners.spotlight: Showed some improvement and ran well from the front when third at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) ten days ago, her fourth start ought to be a tough nut to crack here.
runners.comment: Ran well from the front when placed at Nottingham recently; has another big role to play

runners.name: Nzuri
runners.spotlight: Looks pretty exposed after seven starts but has made the frame in two run-of-the-mill handicaps for her new stable this month (6f/5f) and has a decent chance at the weights here; sports first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Made frame in two run-of-the-mill handicaps for new yard this month; weights chance here

runners.name: Kodicall
runners.spotlight: A big-priced outsider for recent debut at Ffos Las (5f, good) but shaped with promise before fading into fifth of seven; ought to have learnt from that experience and this race looks easier; can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Shaped quite well when fifth of seven at big odds at Ffos Las recently; interesting
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

runners.name: Elmfield
runners.spotlight: Raced far too freely and showed only minor promise on her first two starts (both 6f); open to improvement at some stage but will remain a risky option until she learns to settle.
runners.comment: Raced far too freely and showed only minor promise on her first two starts (both 6f)

runners.name: Kaiko
runners.spotlight: Struggled at triple-digit odds in two 1m novice races in May/June (hung violently left-handed last time); now tries sprinting.
runners.comment: Struggled at triple-digit odds in two 1m novice races in May/June; now tries sprinting

runners.name: It's A Mugs Game
runners.spotlight: Left James Tate after finishing down the field over C&D (soft) on debut in September; returns having been gelded; might be seen to better effect on today's faster ground but is not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Left James Tate after finishing down the field over C&D (soft) on debut in September

races.race_name: Thank You Great Western Air Ambulance Handicap

runners.name: Beerwah
runners.spotlight: Northern raider who has won twice on fast ground over 5f this season; had poor track position when below form at Beverley recently; no surprise if he bounces back quickly over this slightly longer trip.
runners.comment: Dual 5f winner this season; had excuse last time (poor track position); likely contender

runners.name: Connie's Rose
runners.spotlight: Perhaps best known as a Chepstow regular but this track also suits her; yet to win this season but has been placed three times (5f/7f) and her current mark is workable; no surprise if she features.
runners.comment: Yet to win this season but has been placed three times and her current mark is workable

runners.name: Candy Warhol
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW who ran well from the front when second at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) ten days ago; 0-13 on turf but remains 6lb lower than when second over C&D (firm) in May; could be hard to catch.
runners.comment: Second on AW last week and still 6lb lower than when filling that position over C&D in May
runners.owner: Homecroft Wealth, Paul J Dixon & Partners

runners.name: Nordic Glory
runners.spotlight: Has much better strike-rate on AW but recovered from slow start to win here (5f, firm) on turf return in May, and this longer trip will arguably suit him better; needs to bounce back from two down-the-field runs but was denied a clear run on first occasion; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Needs to rebound from two down-the-fied runs but won here (5f) in May and can't rule out

runners.name: Payforanother Daay
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; not disgraced when fifth of seven behind Nordic Glory here (5f, firm) on seasonal debut in May but a lesser effort over C&D followed and others in this field have much stronger claims; tongue-tie removed after one use.
runners.comment: Safely held in C&D classified last month and now 0-12; others have more obvious claims

runners.name: Racing Demon
runners.spotlight: Now 2lb lower than when going close at Chepstow (1m, good) last month and will also be suited by today's longer trip but this regressive and inconsistent 6yo is on a long losing run, and his habit of starting slowly is always a worry.
runners.comment: Went close off 2lb higher last month but this regressive 6yo is often a slow starter

runners.name: Blue Hero
runners.spotlight: Gained all ten wins at this track, the latest in 1m classified at start of this month; close second in handicap over that trip here (again on firm) a fortnight later and will be fine back over 1m2f but recent 4lb rise might leave this 8yo a shade vulnerable.
runners.comment: Ten course wins; in good form this month but recent 4lb rise might leave him vulnerable

runners.name: Offiah's Boy
runners.spotlight: Won three times last summer (twice over 11.6f on fast ground here) but has been soundly beaten on all three starts since returning from a break in June; needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Won three times (twice here) last summer but has been out of form lately

runners.name: Hammal
runners.spotlight: Managed only sixth of nine when upped to 1m2f at Ffos Las (good) this month and has now been unplaced all seven starts; needs help from the new cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Unplaced all seven starts and needs help from the new cheekpieces

runners.name: Miss Colette
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise as a 2yo (four runs; 6f-1m) and is out of the weights for this seasonal debut but had wind surgery in March and wouldn't be the first from her stable to show huge improvement once switched to a middle-distance handicap as a 3yo.
runners.comment: No promise as a 2yo but could be a different proposition in middle-distance handicaps

runners.name: All About George
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was allowed to set a steady pace when fourth of nine at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) a week ago and is effectively 1lb higher here; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden; allowed to set steady pace when fourth at Chepstow last week
